text_en: And Moab rebelled against Israel , after the death of Achab .
text_la: Prævaricatus est autem Moab in Israël, postquam mortuus est Achab.
text_pt: E depois da morte de Acabe, Moabe se rebelou contra Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἠθέτησεν Μωαβ ἐν Ισραηλ μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν Αχααβ

text_en: And Ochozias fell through the lattices of his upper chamber, which he had in Samaria , and was sick: and he sent messengers, saying to them: Go, consult Beelzebub , the god of Accaron , whether I shall recover of this my illness.
text_la: Ceciditque Ochozias per cancellos cœnaculi sui, quod habebat in Samaria, et ægrotavit : misitque nuntios, dicens ad eos : Ite, consulite Beelzebub deum Accaron, utrum vivere queam de infirmitate mea hac.
text_pt: E caiu Acazias pelas grades de um quarto alto, que tinha em Samaria, e adoeceu; e enviou mensageiros, e disse-lhes: Ide, e perguntai a Baal-Zebube, deus de Ecrom, se sararei desta doença.
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσεν Οχοζιας διὰ τοῦ δικτυωτοῦ τοῦ ἐν τῷ ὑπερῴῳ αὐτοῦ τῷ ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ καὶ ἠρρώστησεν καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς δεῦτε καὶ ἐπιζητήσατε ἐν τῇ Βααλ μυῖαν θεὸν Ακκαρων εἰ ζήσομαι ἐκ τῆς ἀρρωστίας μου ταύτης καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ἐπερωτῆσαι δι' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And an angel of the Lord spoke to Elias , the Thesbite, saying: Arise, and go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria , and say to them: Is there not a God in Israel , that you go to consult Beelzebub , the god of Accaron ?
text_la: Angelus autem Domini locutus est ad Eliam Thesbiten, dicens : Surge, et ascende in occursum nuntiorum regis Samariæ, et dices ad eos : Numquid non est Deus in Israël, ut eatis ad consulendum Beelzebub deum Accaron?
text_pt: Mas o anjo do Senhor disse a Elias, o tisbita: Levanta-te, sobe para te encontrares com os mensageiros do rei de Samaria, e dize-lhes: Porventura não há Deus em Israel, para irdes consultar a Baal-Zebube, deus de Ecrom?
text_el: καὶ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐλάλησεν πρὸς Ηλιου τὸν Θεσβίτην λέγων ἀναστὰς δεῦρο εἰς συνάντησιν τῶν ἀγγέλων Οχοζιου βασιλέως Σαμαρείας καὶ λαλήσεις πρὸς αὐτούς εἰ παρὰ τὸ μὴ εἶναι θεὸν ἐν Ισραηλ ὑμεῖς πορεύεσθε ἐπιζητῆσαι ἐν τῇ Βααλ μυῖαν θεὸν Ακκαρων

text_en: Wherefore, thus says the Lord : From the bed, on which you have gone up, you shall not come down, but you shall surely die. And Elias went away.
text_la: Quam ob rem hæc dicit Dominus : De lectulo, super quem ascendisti, non descendes, sed morte morieris. Et abiit Elias.
text_pt: E por isso assim diz o Senhor: Da cama, a que subiste, não descerás, mas sem falta morrerás. Então Elias partiu.
text_el: καὶ οὐχ οὕτως ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος ἡ κλίνη ἐφ' ἧς ἀνέβης ἐκεῖ οὐ καταβήσῃ ἀπ' αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐκεῖ θανάτῳ ἀποθανῇ καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ηλιου καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: And the messengers turned back to Ochozias. And he said to them: Why are you come back?
text_la: Reversique sunt nuntii ad Ochoziam. Qui dixit eis : Quare reversi estis?
text_pt: E os mensageiros voltaram para ele; e ele lhes disse: Que há, que voltastes?
text_el: καὶ ἐπεστράφησαν οἱ ἄγγελοι πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς τί ὅτι ἐπεστρέψατε

text_en: But they answered him: A man met us, and said to us: Go, and return to the king, that sent you, and you shall say to him: Thus says the Lord : Is it because there was no God in Israel , that you send to Beelzebub , the god of Accaron ? Therefore you shall not come down from the bed, on which you have gone up, but you shall surely die.
text_la: At illi responderunt ei : Vir occurrit nobis, et dixit ad nos : Ite, et revertimini ad regem qui misit vos, et dicetis ei : Hæc dicit Dominus : Numquid quia non erat Deus in Israël, mittis ut consulatur Beelzebub deus Accaron? idcirco de lectulo, super quem ascendisti, non descendes, sed morte morieris.
text_pt: E eles lhe disseram: Um homem saiu ao nosso encontro, e nos disse: Ide, voltai para o rei que vos mandou, e dizei-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor: Porventura não há Deus em Israel, para que mandes consultar a Baal-Zebube, deus de Ecrom? Portanto da cama, a que subiste, não descerás, mas sem falta morrerás.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν ἀνὴρ ἀνέβη εἰς συνάντησιν ἡμῶν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς ἡμᾶς δεῦτε ἐπιστράφητε πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα τὸν ἀποστείλαντα ὑμᾶς καὶ λαλήσατε πρὸς αὐτόν τάδε λέγει κύριος εἰ παρὰ τὸ μὴ εἶναι θεὸν ἐν Ισραηλ σὺ πορεύῃ ζητῆσαι ἐν τῇ Βααλ μυῖαν θεὸν Ακκαρων οὐχ οὕτως ἡ κλίνη ἐφ' ἧς ἀνέβης ἐκεῖ οὐ καταβήσῃ ἀπ' αὐτῆς ὅτι θανάτῳ ἀποθανῇ

text_en: And he said to them: What manner of man was he who met you, and spoke these words?
text_la: Qui dixit eis : Cujus figuræ et habitus est vir ille, qui occurrit vobis, et locutus est verba hæc?
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Qual era a aparência do homem que veio ao vosso encontro e vos falou estas palavras?
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγων τίς ἡ κρίσις τοῦ ἀνδρὸς τοῦ ἀναβάντος εἰς συνάντησιν ὑμῖν καὶ λαλήσαντος πρὸς ὑμᾶς τοὺς λόγους τούτους

text_en: But they said: A hairy man , with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said: It is Elias , the Thesbite.
text_la: At illi dixerunt : Vir pilosus, et zona pellicea accinctus renibus. Qui ait : Elias Thesbites est.
text_pt: E eles lhe disseram: Era um homem peludo, e com os lombos cingidos de um cinto de couro. Então disse ele: É Elias, o tisbita.
text_el: καὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτόν ἀνὴρ δασὺς καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περιεζωσμένος τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Ηλιου ὁ Θεσβίτης οὗτός ἐστιν

text_en: And he sent to him a captain of fifty, and the fifty men that were under him. And he went up to him, and as he was sitting on the top of a hill, he said to him: Man of God , the king has commanded that you come down.
text_la: Misitque ad eum quinquagenarium principem, et quinquaginta qui erant sub eo. Qui ascendit ad eum : sedentique in vertice montis, ait : Homo Dei, rex præcepit ut descendas.
text_pt: Então o rei lhe enviou um capitão de cinqüenta com seus cinqüenta; e, subindo a ele (porque eis que estava assentado no cume do monte), disse-lhe: Homem de Deus, o rei diz: Desce.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡγούμενον πεντηκόνταρχον καὶ τοὺς πεντήκοντα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνέβη καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ἰδοὺ Ηλιου ἐκάθητο ἐπὶ τῆς κορυφῆς τοῦ ὄρους καὶ ἐλάλησεν ὁ πεντηκόνταρχος πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν ἄνθρωπε τοῦ θεοῦ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐκάλεσέν σε κατάβηθι

text_en: And Elias answering, said to the captain of fifty: If I be a man of God , let fire come down from heaven and consume you, and your fifty. And there came down fire from heaven and consumed him, and the fifty that were with him.
text_la: Respondensque Elias, dixit quinquagenario : Si homo Dei sum, descendat ignis de cælo, et devoret te, et quinquaginta tuos. Descendit itaque ignis de cælo, et devoravit eum, et quinquaginta qui erant cum eo.
text_pt: Mas Elias respondeu, e disse ao capitão de cinqüenta: Se eu, pois, sou homem de Deus, desça fogo do céu, e te consuma a ti e aos teus cinqüenta. Então fogo desceu do céu, e consumiu a ele e aos seus cinqüenta.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Ηλιου καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν πεντηκόνταρχον καὶ εἰ ἄνθρωπος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐγώ καταβήσεται πῦρ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ καταφάγεταί σε καὶ τοὺς πεντήκοντά σου καὶ κατέβη πῦρ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτὸν καὶ τοὺς πεντήκοντα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he again sent to him another captain of fifty men , and his fifty with him. And he said to him: Man of God : Thus says the king: Make haste and come down.
text_la: Rursumque misit ad eum principem quinquagenarium alterum, et quinquaginta cum eo. Qui locutus est illi : Homo Dei, hæc dicit rex : Festina, descende.
text_pt: E tornou o rei a enviar-lhe outro capitão de cinqüenta, com os seus cinqüenta; ele lhe respondeu, dizendo: Homem de Deus, assim diz o rei: Desce depressa.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἄλλον πεντηκόνταρχον καὶ τοὺς πεντήκοντα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνέβη καὶ ἐλάλησεν ὁ πεντηκόνταρχος πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν ἄνθρωπε τοῦ θεοῦ τάδε λέγει ὁ βασιλεύς ταχέως κατάβηθι

text_en: Elias answering, said: If I be a man of God , let fire come down from heaven , and consume you, and your fifty. And fire came down from heaven , and consumed him and his fifty.
text_la: Respondens Elias, ait : Si homo Dei ego sum, descendat ignis de cælo, et devoret te, et quinquaginta tuos. Descendit ergo ignis de cælo, et devoravit illum, et quinquaginta ejus.
text_pt: E respondeu Elias: Se eu sou homem de Deus, desça fogo do céu, e te consuma a ti e aos teus cinqüenta. Então o fogo de Deus desceu do céu, e o consumiu a ele e aos seus cinqüenta.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Ηλιου καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν εἰ ἄνθρωπος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐγώ εἰμι καταβήσεται πῦρ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ καταφάγεταί σε καὶ τοὺς πεντήκοντά σου καὶ κατέβη πῦρ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτὸν καὶ τοὺς πεντήκοντα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Again he sent a third captain of fifty men , and the fifty that were with him. And when he had come, he fell upon his knees before Elias , and besought him, and said: Man of God , despise not my life, and the lives of your servants that are with me.
text_la: Iterum misit principem quinquagenarium tertium, et quinquaginta qui erant cum eo. Qui cum venisset, curvavit genua contra Eliam, et precatus est eum, et ait : Homo Dei, noli despicere animam meam, et animas servorum tuorum qui mecum sunt.
text_pt: E tornou a enviar um terceiro capitão de cinqüenta, com os seus cinqüenta; então subiu o capitão de cinqüenta e, chegando, pôs-se de joelhos diante de Elias, e suplicou-lhe, dizendo: Homem de Deus, seja, peço-te, preciosa aos teus olhos a minha vida, e a vida destes cinqüenta teus servos.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο ὁ βασιλεὺς ἔτι ἀποστεῖλαι ἡγούμενον πεντηκόνταρχον τρίτον καὶ τοὺς πεντήκοντα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ πεντηκόνταρχος ὁ τρίτος καὶ ἔκαμψεν ἐπὶ τὰ γόνατα αὐτοῦ κατέναντι Ηλιου καὶ ἐδεήθη αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν ἄνθρωπε τοῦ θεοῦ ἐντιμωθήτω δὴ ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ τῶν δούλων σου τούτων τῶν πεντήκοντα ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου

text_en: Behold fire came down from heaven , and consumed the two first captains of fifty men , and the fifties that were with them: but now I beseech you to spare my life.
text_la: Ecce descendit ignis de cælo, et devoravit duos principes quinquagenarios primos, et quinquagenos qui cum eis erant : sed nunc obsecro ut miserearis animæ meæ.
text_pt: Eis que fogo desceu do céu, e consumiu aqueles dois primeiros capitães de cinqüenta, com os seus cinqüenta; porém, agora seja preciosa aos teus olhos a minha vida.
text_el: ἰδοὺ κατέβη πῦρ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ κατέφαγεν τοὺς δύο πεντηκοντάρχους τοὺς πρώτους καὶ τοὺς πεντήκοντα αὐτῶν καὶ νῦν ἐντιμωθήτω δὴ ἡ ψυχὴ τῶν δούλων σου ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου

text_en: And the angel of the Lord spoke to Elias , saying: Go down with him, fear not. He arose therefore, and went down with him to the king,
text_la: Locutus est autem angelus Domini ad Eliam, dicens : Descende cum eo : ne timeas. Surrexit igitur, et descendit cum eo ad regem,
text_pt: Então o anjo do Senhor disse a Elias: Desce com este, não temas. E levantou-se, e desceu com ele ao rei.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν ἄγγελος κυρίου πρὸς Ηλιου καὶ εἶπεν κατάβηθι μετ' αὐτοῦ μὴ φοβηθῇς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνέστη Ηλιου καὶ κατέβη μετ' αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα

text_en: and said to him: Thus says the Lord : Because you have sent messengers to consult Beelzebub , the god of Accaron , as though there were not a God in Israel , of whom you might inquire the word; therefore, from the bed on which you have gone up, you shall not come down, but you shall surely die.
text_la: et locutus est ei : Hæc dicit Dominus : Quia misisti nuntios ad consulendum Beelzebub deum Accaron, quasi non esset Deus in Israël a quo posses interrogare sermonem, ideo de lectulo super quem ascendisti, non descendes, sed morte morieris.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor: Por que enviaste mensageiros a consultar a Baal-Zebube, deus de Ecrom? Porventura é porque não há Deus em Israel, para consultar a sua palavra? Portanto desta cama, a que subiste, não descerás, mas certamente morrerás.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν Ηλιου τάδε λέγει κύριος τί ὅτι ἀπέστειλας ἀγγέλους ζητῆσαι ἐν τῇ Βααλ μυῖαν θεὸν Ακκαρων οὐχ οὕτως ἡ κλίνη ἐφ' ἧς ἀνέβης ἐκεῖ οὐ καταβήσῃ ἀπ' αὐτῆς ὅτι θανάτῳ ἀποθανῇ

text_en: So he died, according to the word of the Lord , which Elias spoke; and Joram, his brother, reigned in his stead, in the second year of Joram, the son of Josaphat, king of Juda , because he had no son.
text_la: Mortuus est ergo juxta sermonem Domini quem locutus est Elias, et regnavit Joram frater ejus pro eo, anno secundo Joram filii Josaphat regis Judæ : non enim habebat filium.
text_pt: Assim, pois, morreu, conforme a palavra do Senhor, que Elias falara; e Jorão começou a reinar no seu lugar no ano segundo de Jeorão, filho de Jeosafá, rei de Judá; porquanto não tinha filho.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου ὃ ἐλάλησεν Ηλιου

text_en: But the rest of the acts of Ochozias, which he did, are they not written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Israel ?
text_la: Reliqua autem verborum Ochoziæ quæ operatus est, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Israël?
text_pt: O mais dos atos de Acazias, tudo quanto fez, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
text_el: καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν λόγων Οχοζιου ὅσα ἐποίησεν οὐκ ἰδοὺ ταῦτα γεγραμμένα ἐπὶ βιβλίου λόγων τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν Ισραηλ

text_en: And it came to pass, when the Lord would take up Elias , into heaven , by a whirlwind, that Elias and Eliseus were going from Galgal.
text_la: Factum est autem cum levare vellet Dominus Eliam per turbinem in cælum, ibant Elias et Eliseus de Galgalis.
text_pt: Sucedeu que, quando o SENHOR estava para elevar a Elias num redemoinho ao céu, Elias partiu de Gilgal com Eliseu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἀνάγειν κύριον τὸν Ηλιου ἐν συσσεισμῷ ὡς εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ηλιου καὶ Ελισαιε ἐκ Γαλγαλων

text_en: And Elias said to Eliseus : Stay here, because the Lord has sent me as far as Bethel . And Eliseus said to him: As the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And when they had come down to Bethel ,
text_la: Dixitque Elias ad Eliseum : Sede hic, quia Dominus misit me usque in Bethel. Cui ait Eliseus : Vivit Dominus, et vivit anima tua, quia non derelinquam te. Cumque descendissent Bethel,
text_pt: E disse Elias a Eliseu: Fica-te aqui, porque o Senhor me enviou a Betel. Porém Eliseu disse: Vive o Senhor, e vive a tua alma, que não te deixarei. E assim foram a Betel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ηλιου πρὸς Ελισαιε κάθου δὴ ἐνταῦθα ὅτι κύριος ἀπέσταλκέν με ἕως Βαιθηλ καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε ζῇ κύριος καὶ ζῇ ἡ ψυχή σου εἰ καταλείψω σε καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Βαιθηλ

text_en: the sons of the prophets , that were at Bethel , came forth to Eliseus , and said to him: Do you know that, this day, the Lord will take away your master from you? And he answered: I also know it: hold your peace.
text_la: egressi sunt filii prophetarum qui erant in Bethel, ad Eliseum, et dixerunt ei : Numquid nosti quia hodie Dominus tollet dominum tuum a te? Qui respondit : Et ego novi : silete.
text_pt: Então os filhos dos profetas que estavam em Betel saíram ao encontro de Eliseu, e lhe disseram: Sabes que o SENHOR hoje tomará o teu senhor por sobre a tua cabeça? E ele disse: Também eu bem o sei; calai-vos.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν προφητῶν οἱ ἐν Βαιθηλ πρὸς Ελισαιε καὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτόν εἰ ἔγνως ὅτι κύριος σήμερον λαμβάνει τὸν κύριόν σου ἐπάνωθεν τῆς κεφαλῆς σου καὶ εἶπεν κἀγὼ ἔγνωκα σιωπᾶτε

text_en: And Elias said to Eliseus : Stay here, because the Lord has sent me to Jericho . And he said: As the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And when they had come to Jericho ,
text_la: Dixit autem Elias ad Eliseum : Sede hic, quia Dominus misit me in Jericho. Et ille ait : Vivit Dominus, et vivit anima tua, quia non derelinquam te. Cumque venissent Jericho,
text_pt: E Elias lhe disse: Eliseu, fica-te aqui, porque o Senhor me enviou a Jericó. Porém ele disse: Vive o Senhor, e vive a tua alma, que não te deixarei. E assim foram a Jericó.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ηλιου πρὸς Ελισαιε κάθου δὴ ἐνταῦθα ὅτι κύριος ἀπέσταλκέν με εἰς Ιεριχω καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε ζῇ κύριος καὶ ζῇ ἡ ψυχή σου εἰ ἐγκαταλείψω σε καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Ιεριχω

text_en: the sons of the prophets , that were at Jericho , came to Eliseus , and said to him: Do you know that, this day, the Lord will take away your master from you? And he said: I also know it: hold your peace.
text_la: accesserunt filii prophetarum qui erant in Jericho, ad Eliseum, et dixerunt ei : Numquid nosti quia Dominus hodie tollet dominum tuum a te? Et ait : Et ego novi : silete.
text_pt: Então os filhos dos profetas que estavam em Jericó se chegaram a Eliseu, e lhe disseram: Sabes que o SENHOR hoje tomará o teu senhor por sobre a tua cabeça? E ele disse: Também eu bem o sei; calai-vos.
text_el: καὶ ἤγγισαν οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν προφητῶν οἱ ἐν Ιεριχω πρὸς Ελισαιε καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν εἰ ἔγνως ὅτι σήμερον λαμβάνει κύριος τὸν κύριόν σου ἐπάνωθεν τῆς κεφαλῆς σου καὶ εἶπεν καί γε ἐγὼ ἔγνων σιωπᾶτε

text_en: And Elias said to him: Stay here, because the Lord has sent me as far as the Jordan . And he said: as the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And they two went on together.
text_la: Dixit autem ei Elias : Sede hic, quia Dominus misit me usque ad Jordanem. Qui ait : Vivit Dominus, et vivit anima tua, quia non derelinquam te. Ierunt igitur ambo pariter,
text_pt: E Elias disse: Fica-te aqui, porque o Senhor me enviou ao Jordão. Mas ele disse: Vive o Senhor, e vive a tua alma, que não te deixarei. E assim ambos foram juntos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ηλιου κάθου δὴ ὧδε ὅτι κύριος ἀπέσταλκέν με ἕως τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε ζῇ κύριος καὶ ζῇ ἡ ψυχή σου εἰ ἐγκαταλείψω σε καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ἀμφότεροι

text_en: And fifty men , of the sons of the prophets , followed them, and stood in sight, at a distance: but they two stood by the Jordan .
text_la: et quinquaginta viri de filiis prophetarum secuti sunt eos, qui et steterunt e contra, longe : illi autem ambo stabant super Jordanem.
text_pt: E foram cinqüenta homens dos filhos dos profetas, e pararam defronte deles, de longe: e assim ambos pararam junto ao Jordão.
text_el: καὶ πεντήκοντα ἄνδρες υἱοὶ τῶν προφητῶν καὶ ἔστησαν ἐξ ἐναντίας μακρόθεν καὶ ἀμφότεροι ἔστησαν ἐπὶ τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: And Elias took his mantle, and folded it together, and struck the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, and they both passed over on dry ground.
text_la: Tulitque Elias pallium suum, et involvit illud, et percussit aquas : quæ divisæ sunt in utramque partem, et transierunt ambo per siccum.
text_pt: Então Elias tomou a sua capa e a dobrou, e feriu as águas, as quais se dividiram para os dois lados; e passaram ambos em seco.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ηλιου τὴν μηλωτὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἵλησεν καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ διῃρέθη τὸ ὕδωρ ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα καὶ διέβησαν ἀμφότεροι ἐν ἐρήμῳ

text_en: And when they had gone over, Elias said to Eliseus : Ask what you will have me to do for you, before I be taken away from you. And Eliseus said: I beseech you, that in me may be your double spirit.
text_la: Cumque transissent, Elias dixit ad Eliseum : Postula quod vis ut faciam tibi, antequam tollar a te. Dixitque Eliseus : Obsecro ut fiat in me duplex spiritus tuus.
text_pt: Sucedeu que, havendo eles passado, Elias disse a Eliseu: Pede-me o que queres que te faça, antes que seja tomado de ti. E disse Eliseu: Peço-te que haja porção dobrada de teu espírito sobre mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ διαβῆναι αὐτοὺς καὶ Ηλιου εἶπεν πρὸς Ελισαιε αἴτησαι τί ποιήσω σοι πρὶν ἢ ἀναλημφθῆναί με ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε γενηθήτω δὴ διπλᾶ ἐν πνεύματί σου ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: And he answered: You have asked a hard thing; nevertheless, if you see me when I am taken from you, you shall have what you have asked: but if you see me not, you shall not have it.
text_la: Qui respondit : Rem difficilem postulasti : attamen si videris me quando tollar a te, erit tibi quod petisti : si autem non videris, non erit.
text_pt: E disse: Coisa difícil pediste; se me vires quando for tomado de ti, assim se te fará, porém, se não, não se fará.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ηλιου ἐσκλήρυνας τοῦ αἰτήσασθαι ἐὰν ἴδῃς με ἀναλαμβανόμενον ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ἔσται σοι οὕτως καὶ ἐὰν μή οὐ μὴ γένηται

text_en: And as they went on, walking and talking together, behold, a fiery chariot and fiery horses parted them both asunder: and Elias went up by a whirlwind into heaven .
text_la: Cumque pergerent, et incedentes sermocinarentur, ecce currus igneus, et equi ignei diviserunt utrumque : et ascendit Elias per turbinem in cælum.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, indo eles andando e falando, eis que um carro de fogo, com cavalos de fogo, os separou um do outro; e Elias subiu ao céu num redemoinho.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτῶν πορευομένων ἐπορεύοντο καὶ ἐλάλουν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἅρμα πυρὸς καὶ ἵπποι πυρὸς καὶ διέστειλαν ἀνὰ μέσον ἀμφοτέρων καὶ ἀνελήμφθη Ηλιου ἐν συσσεισμῷ ὡς εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν

text_en: And Eliseus saw him, and cried: My father, my father, the chariot of Israel , and the driver thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own garments, and rent them in two pieces.
text_la: Eliseus autem videbat, et clamabat : Pater mi, pater mi, currus Israël, et auriga ejus. Et non vidit eum amplius : apprehenditque vestimenta sua, et scidit illa in duas partes.
text_pt: O que vendo Eliseu, clamou: Meu pai, meu pai, carros de Israel, e seus cavaleiros! E nunca mais o viu; e, pegando as suas vestes, rasgou-as em duas partes.
text_el: καὶ Ελισαιε ἑώρα καὶ ἐβόα πάτερ πάτερ ἅρμα Ισραηλ καὶ ἱππεὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ εἶδεν αὐτὸν ἔτι καὶ ἐπελάβετο τῶν ἱματίων αὐτοῦ καὶ διέρρηξεν αὐτὰ εἰς δύο ῥήγματα

text_en: And he took up the mantle of Elias , that fell from him: and going back, he stood on the bank of the Jordan ;
text_la: Et levavit pallium Eliæ, quod ceciderat ei : reversusque stetit super ripam Jordanis,
text_pt: Também levantou a capa de Elias, que dele caíra; e, voltando-se, parou à margem do Jordão.
text_el: καὶ ὕψωσεν τὴν μηλωτὴν Ηλιου ἣ ἔπεσεν ἐπάνωθεν Ελισαιε καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Ελισαιε καὶ ἔστη ἐπὶ τοῦ χείλους τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: and he struck the waters with the mantle of Elias , that had fallen from him, and they were not divided. And he said: Where is now the God of Elias ? And he struck the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, and Eliseus passed over.
text_la: et pallio Eliæ, quod ceciderat ei, percussit aquas, et non sunt divisæ : et dixit : Ubi est Deus Eliæ etiam nunc? Percussitque aquas, et divisæ sunt huc atque illuc, et transiit Eliseus.
text_pt: E tomou a capa de Elias, que dele caíra, e feriu as águas, e disse: Onde está o Senhor Deus de Elias? Quando feriu as águas elas se dividiram de um ao outro lado; e Eliseu passou.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν μηλωτὴν Ηλιου ἣ ἔπεσεν ἐπάνωθεν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ οὐ διέστη καὶ εἶπεν ποῦ ὁ θεὸς Ηλιου αφφω καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὰ ὕδατα καὶ διερράγησαν ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα καὶ διέβη Ελισαιε

text_en: And the sons of the prophets , at Jericho , who were over against him, seeing it, said: The spirit of Elias has rested upon Eliseus . And coming to meet him, they worshipped him, falling to the ground.
text_la: Videntes autem filii prophetarum qui erant in Jericho e contra, dixerunt : Requievit spiritus Eliæ super Eliseum. Et venientes in occursum ejus, adoraverunt eum proni in terram,
text_pt: Vendo-o, pois, os filhos dos profetas que estavam defronte em Jericó, disseram: O espírito de Elias repousa sobre Eliseu. E vieram-lhe ao encontro, e se prostraram diante dele em terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον αὐτὸν οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν προφητῶν οἱ ἐν Ιεριχω ἐξ ἐναντίας καὶ εἶπον ἐπαναπέπαυται τὸ πνεῦμα Ηλιου ἐπὶ Ελισαιε καὶ ἦλθον εἰς συναντὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And they said to him: Behold, there are with your servants, fifty strong men , that can go, and seek your master, lest, perhaps, the spirit of the Lord , has taken him up and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said: Do not send.
text_la: dixeruntque illi : Ecce cum servis tuis sunt quinquaginta viri fortes qui possunt ire, et quærere dominum tuum, ne forte tulerit eum spiritus Domini, et projecerit eum in unum montium, aut in unam vallium. Qui ait : Nolite mittere.
text_pt: E disseram-lhe: Eis que agora entre os teus servos há cinqüenta homens valentes; ora deixa-os ir para buscar a teu senhor; pode ser que o elevasse o Espírito do SENHOR e o lançasse em algum dos montes, ou em algum dos vales. Porém ele disse: Não os envieis.
text_el: καὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτόν ἰδοὺ δὴ μετὰ τῶν παίδων σου πεντήκοντα ἄνδρες υἱοὶ δυνάμεως πορευθέντες δὴ ζητησάτωσαν τὸν κύριόν σου μήποτε ἦρεν αὐτὸν πνεῦμα κυρίου καὶ ἔρριψεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ Ιορδάνῃ ἢ ἐφ' ἓν τῶν ὀρέων ἢ ἐφ' ἕνα τῶν βουνῶν καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε οὐκ ἀποστελεῖτε

text_en: But they pressed him, till he consented, and said: Send. And they sent fifty men : and they sought three days, but found him not.
text_la: Coëgeruntque eum donec acquiesceret, et diceret : Mittite. Et miserunt quinquaginta viros : qui cum quæsissent tribus diebus, non invenerunt.
text_pt: Mas eles insistiram com ele, até que, constrangido, disse-lhes: Enviai. E enviaram cinqüenta homens, que o buscaram três dias, porém não o acharam.
text_el: καὶ παρεβιάσαντο αὐτὸν ἕως ὅτου ᾐσχύνετο καὶ εἶπεν ἀποστείλατε καὶ ἀπέστειλαν πεντήκοντα ἄνδρας καὶ ἐζήτησαν τρεῖς ἡμέρας καὶ οὐχ εὗρον αὐτόν

text_en: And they came back to him: for he abode at Jericho , and he said to them: Did I not say to you? Do not send.
text_la: Et reversi sunt ad eum : at ille habitabat in Jericho, et dixit eis : Numquid non dixi vobis : Nolite mittere?
text_pt: Então voltaram para ele, pois ficara em Jericó; e disse-lhes: Eu não vos disse que não fôsseis?
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψαν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐκάθητο ἐν Ιεριχω καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε οὐκ εἶπον πρὸς ὑμᾶς μὴ πορευθῆτε

text_en: And the men of the city, said to Eliseus : Behold the situation of this city is very good , as you, my lord, see: but the waters are very bad, and the ground barren.
text_la: Dixerunt quoque viri civitatis ad Eliseum : Ecce habitatio civitatis hujus optima est, sicut tu ipse, domine, perspicis : sed aquæ pessimæ sunt, et terra sterilis.
text_pt: E os homens da cidade disseram a Eliseu: Eis que é boa a situação desta cidade, como o meu senhor vê; porém as águas são más, e a terra é estéril.
text_el: καὶ εἶπον οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως πρὸς Ελισαιε ἰδοὺ ἡ κατοίκησις τῆς πόλεως ἀγαθή καθὼς ὁ κύριος βλέπει καὶ τὰ ὕδατα πονηρὰ καὶ ἡ γῆ ἀτεκνουμένη

text_en: And he said: Bring me a new vessel, and put salt into it. And when they had brought it,
text_la: At ille ait : Afferte mihi vas novum, et mittite in illud sal. Quod cum attulissent,
text_pt: E ele disse: Trazei-me um prato novo, e ponde nele sal. E lho trouxeram.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε λάβετέ μοι ὑδρίσκην καινὴν καὶ θέτε ἐκεῖ ἅλα καὶ ἔλαβον πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: he went out to the spring of the waters, and cast the salt into it, and said: Thus says the Lord : I have healed these waters, and there shall be no more in them death or barrenness.
text_la: egressus ad fontem aquarum misit in illum sal, et ait : Hæc dicit Dominus : Sanavi aquas has, et non erit ultra in eis mors, neque sterilitas.
text_pt: Então saiu ele ao manancial das águas, e deitou sal nele; e disse: Assim diz o Senhor: Sararei a estas águas; e não haverá mais nelas morte nem esterilidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ελισαιε εἰς τὴν διέξοδον τῶν ὑδάτων καὶ ἔρριψεν ἐκεῖ ἅλα καὶ εἶπεν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἴαμαι τὰ ὕδατα ταῦτα οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι ἐκεῖθεν θάνατος καὶ ἀτεκνουμένη

text_en: And the waters were healed unto this day, according to the word of Eliseus , which he spoke.
text_la: Sanatæ sunt ergo aquæ usque in diem hanc, juxta verbum Elisei quod locutus est.
text_pt: Ficaram, pois, sãs aquelas águas, até ao dia de hoje, conforme a palavra que Eliseu tinha falado.
text_el: καὶ ἰάθησαν τὰ ὕδατα ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα Ελισαιε ὃ ἐλάλησεν

text_en: And he went up from thence to Bethel : and as he was going up by the way, little boys came out of the city and mocked him, saying: Go up, you bald head, go up, you bald head.
text_la: Ascendit autem inde in Bethel : cumque ascenderet per viam, pueri parvi egressi sunt de civitate, et illudebant ei, dicentes : Ascende calve, ascende calve.
text_pt: Então subiu dali a Betel; e, subindo ele pelo caminho, uns meninos saíram da cidade, e zombavam dele, e diziam-lhe: Sobe, calvo; sobe, calvo!
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη ἐκεῖθεν εἰς Βαιθηλ καὶ ἀναβαίνοντος αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ παιδάρια μικρὰ ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τῆς πόλεως καὶ κατέπαιζον αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπον αὐτῷ ἀνάβαινε φαλακρέ ἀνάβαινε

text_en: And looking back, he saw them, and cursed them in the name of the Lord : and there came forth two bears out of the forest, and tore of them, two and forty boys.
text_la: Qui cum respexisset, vidit eos, et maledixit eis in nomine Domini : egressique sunt duo ursi de saltu, et laceraverunt ex eis quadraginta duos pueros.
text_pt: E, virando-se ele para trás, os viu, e os amaldiçoou no nome do Senhor; então duas ursas saíram do bosque, e despedaçaram quarenta e dois daqueles meninos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξένευσεν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν καὶ εἶδεν αὐτὰ καὶ κατηράσατο αὐτοῖς ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐξῆλθον δύο ἄρκοι ἐκ τοῦ δρυμοῦ καὶ ἀνέρρηξαν ἐξ αὐτῶν τεσσαράκοντα καὶ δύο παῖδας

text_en: And from thence he went to mount Carmel , and from thence he returned to Samaria .
text_la: Abiit autem inde in montem Carmeli, et inde reversus est in Samariam.
text_pt: E dali foi para o monte Carmelo de onde voltou para Samaria.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Καρμήλιον καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἐπέστρεψεν εἰς Σαμάρειαν

text_en: And Joram the son of Achab , reigned over Israel , in Samaria , in the eighteenth year of Josaphat, king of Juda . And he reigned twelve years.
text_la: Joram vero filius Achab regnavit super Israël in Samaria anno decimooctavo Josaphat regis Judæ: regnavitque duodecim annis.
text_pt: E Jorão, filho de Acabe, começou a reinar sobre Israel, em Samaria, no décimo oitavo ano de Jeosafá, rei de Judá; e reinou doze anos.
text_el: καὶ Ιωραμ υἱὸς Αχααβ ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ισραηλ ἐν ἔτει ὀκτωκαιδεκάτῳ Ιωσαφατ βασιλεῖ Ιουδα καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν δώδεκα ἔτη

text_en: And he did evil before the Lord , but not like his father and his mother: for he took away the statues of Baal , which his father had made.
text_la: Et fecit malum coram Domino, sed non sicut pater suus et mater : tulit enim statuas Baal quas fecerat pater ejus.
text_pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor; porém não como seu pai, nem como sua mãe; porque tirou a estátua de Baal, que seu pai fizera.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ πονηρὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς κυρίου πλὴν οὐχ ὡς ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐχ ὡς ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ μετέστησεν τὰς στήλας τοῦ Βααλ ἃς ἐποίησεν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Nevertheless, he stuck to the sins of Jeroboam , the son of Nabat, who made Israel to sin , nor did he depart from them.
text_la: Verumtamen in peccatis Jeroboam filii Nabat, qui peccare fecit Israël, adhæsit, nec recessit ab eis.
text_pt: Contudo aderiu aos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com que fizera Israel pecar; não se apartou deles.
text_el: πλὴν ἐν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ Ιεροβοαμ υἱοῦ Ναβατ ὃς ἐξήμαρτεν τὸν Ισραηλ ἐκολλήθη οὐκ ἀπέστη ἀπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: Now Mesa , king of Moab , nourished many sheep, and he paid to the king of Israel a hundred thousand lambs, and a hundred thousand rams, with their fleeces.
text_la: Porro Mesa rex Moab nutriebat pecora multa, et solvebat regi Israël centum millia agnorum, et centum millia arietum cum velleribus suis.
text_pt: Então Mesa, rei dos moabitas, era criador de gado, e pagava de tributo, ao rei de Israel, cem mil cordeiros, e cem mil carneiros com a sua lã.
text_el: καὶ Μωσα βασιλεὺς Μωαβ ἦν νωκηδ καὶ ἐπέστρεφεν τῷ βασιλεῖ Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἐπαναστάσει ἑκατὸν χιλιάδας ἀρνῶν καὶ ἑκατὸν χιλιάδας κριῶν ἐπὶ πόκων

text_en: And when Achab was dead, he broke the league which he had made with the king of Israel .
text_la: Cumque mortuus fuisset Achab, prævaricatus est fœdus quod habebat cum rege Israël.
text_pt: Sucedeu, porém, que, morrendo Acabe, o rei dos moabitas se rebelou contra o rei de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν Αχααβ καὶ ἠθέτησεν βασιλεὺς Μωαβ ἐν βασιλεῖ Ισραηλ

text_en: And King Joram went out that day from Samaria , and mustered all Israel .
text_la: Egressus est igitur rex Joram in die illa de Samaria, et recensuit universum Israël.
text_pt: Por isso Jorão ao mesmo tempo saiu de Samaria, e fez revista de todo o Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ιωραμ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐκ Σαμαρείας καὶ ἐπεσκέψατο τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And he sent to Josaphat; king of Juda , saying: The king of Moab is revolted from me: come with me against him to battle. And he answered: I will come up: he that is mine, is yours: my people are your people: and my horses, your horses.
text_la: Misitque ad Josaphat regem Juda, dicens : Rex Moab recessit a me : veni mecum contra eum ad prælium. Qui respondit : Ascendam : qui meus est, tuus est : populus meus, populus tuus, et equi mei, equi tui.
text_pt: E foi, e mandou dizer a Jeosafá, rei de Judá: O rei dos moabitas se rebelou contra mim; irás tu comigo à guerra contra os moabitas? E disse ele: Subirei; e eu serei como tu, o meu povo como o teu povo, e os meus cavalos como os teus cavalos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν πρὸς Ιωσαφατ βασιλέα Ιουδα λέγων βασιλεὺς Μωαβ ἠθέτησεν ἐν ἐμοί εἰ πορεύσῃ μετ' ἐμοῦ εἰς Μωαβ εἰς πόλεμον καὶ εἶπεν ἀναβήσομαι ὅμοιός μοι ὅμοιός σοι ὡς ὁ λαός μου ὁ λαός σου ὡς οἱ ἵπποι μου οἱ ἵπποι σου

text_en: And he said: Which way shall we go up? But he answered: By the desert of Edom .
text_la: Dixitque : Per quam viam ascendemus? At ille respondit : Per desertum Idumææ.
text_pt: E ele disse: Por que caminho subiremos? Então disse ele: Pelo caminho do deserto de Edom.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ποίᾳ ὁδῷ ἀναβῶ καὶ εἶπεν ὁδὸν ἔρημον Εδωμ

text_en: So the king of Israel , and the king of Juda , and the king of Edom , went, and they fetched a compass of seven days journey, and there was no water for the army, and for the beasts, that followed them.
text_la: Perrexerunt igitur rex Israël, et rex Juda, et rex Edom, et circuierunt per viam septem dierum, nec erat aqua exercitui et jumentis quæ sequebantur eos.
text_pt: E partiram o rei de Israel, o rei de Judá e o rei de Edom; e andaram rodeando com uma marcha de sete dias, e não havia água para o exército e nem para o gado que os seguia.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς Εδωμ καὶ ἐκύκλωσαν ὁδὸν ἑπτὰ ἡμερῶν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὕδωρ τῇ παρεμβολῇ καὶ τοῖς κτήνεσιν τοῖς ἐν τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And the king of Israel said: Alas, alas, alas, the Lord has gathered us three kings together, to deliver us into the hands of Moab .
text_la: Dixitque rex Israël : Heu! heu! heu! congregavit nos Dominus tres reges ut traderet in manus Moab.
text_pt: Então disse o rei de Israel: Ah! o Senhor chamou a estes três reis, para entregá-los nas mãos dos moabitas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ ὦ ὅτι κέκληκεν κύριος τοὺς τρεῖς βασιλεῖς παρερχομένους δοῦναι αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ Μωαβ

text_en: And Josaphat said: Is there not here a prophet of the Lord , that we may beseech the Lord by him? And one of the servants of the king of Israel answered: Here is Eliseus , the son of Saphat, who poured water on the hands of Elias .
text_la: Et ait Josaphat : Estne hic propheta Domini, ut deprecemur Dominum per eum? Et respondit unus de servis regis Israël : Est hic Eliseus filius Saphat, qui fundebat aquam super manus Eliæ.
text_pt: E disse Jeosafá: Não há aqui algum profeta do Senhor, para que consultemos ao Senhor por ele? Então respondeu um dos servos do rei de Israel, dizendo: Aqui está Eliseu, filho de Safate, que derramava água sobre as mãos de Elias.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσαφατ οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε προφήτης τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἐπιζητήσωμεν τὸν κύριον παρ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπεκρίθη εἷς τῶν παίδων βασιλέως Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν ὧδε Ελισαιε υἱὸς Σαφατ ὃς ἐπέχεεν ὕδωρ ἐπὶ χεῖρας Ηλιου

text_en: And Josaphat said: The word of the Lord is with him. And the king of Israel , and Josaphat, king of Juda , and the king of Edom , went down to him.
text_la: Et ait Josaphat : Est apud eum sermo Domini. Descenditque ad eum rex Israël, et Josaphat rex Juda, et rex Edom.
text_pt: E disse Jeosafá: Está com ele a palavra do Senhor. Então o rei de Israel, Jeosafá, e o rei de Edom desceram a ter com ele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσαφατ ἔστιν αὐτῷ ῥῆμα κυρίου καὶ κατέβη πρὸς αὐτὸν βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ Ιωσαφατ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα καὶ βασιλεὺς Εδωμ

text_en: And Eliseus said to the king of Israel : What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and your mother. And the king of Israel said to him: Why has the Lord gathered together these three kings, to deliver them into the hands of Moab ?
text_la: Dixit autem Eliseus ad regem Israël : Quid mihi et tibi est? vade ad prophetas patris tui et matris tuæ. Et ait illi rex Israël : Quare congregavit Dominus tres reges hos ut traderet eos in manus Moab?
text_pt: Mas Eliseu disse ao rei de Israel: Que tenho eu contigo? Vai aos profetas de teu pai e aos profetas de tua mãe. Porém o rei de Israel lhe disse: Não, porque o Senhor chamou a estes três reis para entregá-los nas mãos dos moabitas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε πρὸς βασιλέα Ισραηλ τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί δεῦρο πρὸς τοὺς προφήτας τοῦ πατρός σου καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ μή ὅτι κέκληκεν κύριος τοὺς τρεῖς βασιλεῖς τοῦ παραδοῦναι αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖρας Μωαβ

text_en: And Eliseus said to him: As the Lord of hosts lives, in whose sight I stand, if I did not reverence the face of Josaphat, king of Juda , I would not have hearkened to you, nor looked on you.
text_la: Dixitque ad eum Eliseus : Vivit Dominus exercituum, in cujus conspectu sto, quod si non vultum Josaphat regis Judæ erubescerem, non attendissem quidem te, nec respexissem.
text_pt: E disse Eliseu: Vive o Senhor dos Exércitos, em cuja presença estou, que se eu não respeitasse a presença de Jeosafá, rei de Judá, não olharia para ti nem te veria.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε ζῇ κύριος τῶν δυνάμεων ᾧ παρέστην ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ὅτι εἰ μὴ πρόσωπον Ιωσαφατ βασιλέως Ιουδα ἐγὼ λαμβάνω εἰ ἐπέβλεψα πρὸς σὲ καὶ εἶδόν σε

text_en: But now bring me hither a minstrel. And when the minstrel played, the hand of the Lord came upon him, and he said:
text_la: Nunc autem adducite mihi psaltem. Cumque caneret psaltes, facta est super eum manus Domini, et ait:
text_pt: Ora, pois, trazei-me um músico. E sucedeu que, tocando o músico, veio sobre ele a mão do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ νυνὶ δὲ λαβέ μοι ψάλλοντα καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἔψαλλεν ὁ ψάλλων καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπ' αὐτὸν χεὶρ κυρίου

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Make the channel of this torrent full of ditches.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Facite alveum torrentis hujus fossas et fossas.
text_pt: E disse: Assim diz o Senhor: Fazei neste vale muitas covas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τάδε λέγει κύριος ποιήσατε τὸν χειμάρρουν τοῦτον βοθύνους βοθύνους

text_en: For thus says the Lord : You shall not see wind, nor rain: and yet this channel shall be filled with waters, and you shall drink, you and your families , and your beasts.
text_la: Hæc enim dicit Dominus : Non videbitis ventum, neque pluviam : et alveus iste replebitur aquis, et bibetis vos, et familiæ vestræ, et jumenta vestra.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor: Não vereis vento, e não vereis chuva; todavia este vale se encherá de tanta água, que bebereis vós, o vosso gado e os vossos animais.
text_el: ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος οὐκ ὄψεσθε πνεῦμα καὶ οὐκ ὄψεσθε ὑετόν καὶ ὁ χειμάρρους οὗτος πλησθήσεται ὕδατος καὶ πίεσθε ὑμεῖς καὶ αἱ κτήσεις ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ κτήνη ὑμῶν

text_en: And this is a small thing in the sight of the Lord : moreover, he will deliver, also, Moab into your hands.
text_la: Parumque est hoc in conspectu Domini: insuper tradet etiam Moab in manus vestras.
text_pt: E ainda isto é pouco aos olhos do Senhor; também entregará ele os moabitas nas vossas mãos.
text_el: καὶ κούφη αὕτη ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς κυρίου καὶ παραδώσω τὴν Μωαβ ἐν χειρὶ ὑμῶν

text_en: And you shall destroy every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall cut down every fruitful tree, and shall stop up all the springs of waters, and every goodly field you shall cover with stones.
text_la: Et percutietis omnem civitatem munitam, et omnem urbem electam, et universum lignum fructiferum succidetis, cunctosque fontes aquarum obturabitis, et omnem agrum egregium operietis lapidibus.
text_pt: E ferireis a todas as cidades fortes, e a todas as cidades escolhidas, e todas as boas árvores cortareis, e entupireis todas as fontes de água, e danificareis com pedras todos os bons campos.
text_el: καὶ πατάξετε πᾶσαν πόλιν ὀχυρὰν καὶ πᾶν ξύλον ἀγαθὸν καταβαλεῖτε καὶ πάσας πηγὰς ὕδατος ἐμφράξετε καὶ πᾶσαν μερίδα ἀγαθὴν ἀχρειώσετε ἐν λίθοις

text_en: And it came to pass, in the morning, when the sacrifices used to be offered, that behold, water came by the way of Edom , and the country was filled with water.
text_la: Factum est igitur mane, quando sacrificium offerri solet, et ecce aquæ veniebant per viam Edom, et repleta est terra aquis.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, pela manhã, oferecendo-se a oferta de alimentos, eis que vinham as águas pelo caminho de Edom; e a terra se encheu de água.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τὸ πρωὶ ἀναβαινούσης τῆς θυσίας καὶ ἰδοὺ ὕδατα ἤρχοντο ἐξ ὁδοῦ Εδωμ καὶ ἐπλήσθη ἡ γῆ ὕδατος

text_en: And all the Moabites hearing that the kings had come up to fight against them, gathered together all that were girded with a belt upon them, and stood in the borders.
text_la: Universi autem Moabitæ audientes quod ascendissent reges ut pugnarent adversum eos, convocaverunt omnes qui accincti erant balteo desuper, et steterunt in terminis.
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, todos os moabitas que os reis tinham subido para pelejarem contra eles, convocaram a todos os que estavam em idade de cingir cinto e daí para cima, e puseram-se às fronteiras.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσα Μωαβ ἤκουσαν ὅτι ἀνέβησαν οἱ βασιλεῖς πολεμεῖν αὐτούς καὶ ἀνεβόησαν ἐκ παντὸς περιεζωσμένου ζώνην καὶ ἐπάνω καὶ ἔστησαν ἐπὶ τοῦ ὁρίου

text_en: And they rose early in the morning, and the sun being now up, and shining upon the waters, the Moabites saw the waters over against them red, like blood,
text_la: Primoque mane surgentes, et orto jam sole ex adverso aquarum, viderunt Moabitæ e contra aquas rubras quasi sanguinem,
text_pt: E, levantando-se de madrugada, e saindo o sol sobre as águas, viram os moabitas, defronte deles, as águas vermelhas como sangue.
text_el: καὶ ὤρθρισαν τὸ πρωί καὶ ὁ ἥλιος ἀνέτειλεν ἐπὶ τὰ ὕδατα καὶ εἶδεν Μωαβ ἐξ ἐναντίας τὰ ὕδατα πυρρὰ ὡσεὶ αἷμα

text_en: and they said: It is the blood of the sword: the kings have fought among themselves, and they have killed one another: go now, Moab , to the spoils.
text_la: dixeruntque : Sanguis gladii est : pugnaverunt reges contra se, et cæsi sunt mutuo : nunc perge ad prædam, Moab.
text_pt: E disseram: Isto é sangue; certamente que os reis se destruíram à espada e se mataram um ao outro! Agora, pois, à presa, moabitas!
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αἷμα τοῦτο τῆς ῥομφαίας ἐμαχέσαντο οἱ βασιλεῖς καὶ ἐπάταξαν ἀνὴρ τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ νῦν ἐπὶ τὰ σκῦλα Μωαβ

text_en: And they went into the camp of Israel : but Israel rising up, defeated Moab , who fled before them. And they being conquerors, went and smote Moab .
text_la: Perrexeruntque in castra Israël : porro consurgens Israël, percussit Moab : at illi fugerunt coram eis. Venerunt igitur qui vicerant, et percusserunt Moab,
text_pt: Porém, chegando eles ao arraial de Israel, os israelitas se levantaram, e feriram os moabitas, os quais fugiram diante deles e ainda entraram nas suas terras, ferindo ali também os moabitas.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν Ισραηλ καὶ Ισραηλ ἀνέστησαν καὶ ἐπάταξαν τὴν Μωαβ καὶ ἔφυγον ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰσπορευόμενοι καὶ τύπτοντες τὴν Μωαβ

text_en: And they destroyed the cities: And they filled every goodly field, every man casting his stone: and they stopt up all the springs of waters: and cut down all the trees that bore fruit, so that brick walls only remained: and the city was beset by the slingers, and a great part thereof destroyed.
text_la: et civitates destruxerunt : et omnem agrum optimum, mittentes singuli lapides, repleverunt : et universos fontes aquarum obturaverunt : et omnia ligna fructifera succiderunt, ita ut muri tantum fictiles remanerent : et circumdata est civitas a fundibulariis, et magna ex parte percussa.
text_pt: E arrasaram as cidades, e cada um lançou a sua pedra em todos os bons campos, e os entulharam, e entupiram todas as fontes de água, e cortaram todas as boas árvores, até que só em Quir-Haresete deixaram ficar as pedras, mas os fundeiros a cercaram e a feriram.
text_el: καὶ τὰς πόλεις καθεῖλον καὶ πᾶσαν μερίδα ἀγαθὴν ἔρριψαν ἀνὴρ τὸν λίθον καὶ ἐνέπλησαν αὐτὴν καὶ πᾶσαν πηγὴν ὕδατος ἐνέφραξαν καὶ πᾶν ξύλον ἀγαθὸν κατέβαλον ἕως τοῦ καταλιπεῖν τοὺς λίθους τοῦ τοίχου καθῃρημένους καὶ ἐκύκλευσαν οἱ σφενδονῆται καὶ ἐπάταξαν αὐτήν

text_en: And when the king of Moab saw this, to wit, that the enemies had prevailed, he took with him seven hundred men that drew the sword, to break in upon the king of Edom : but they could not.
text_la: Quod cum vidisset rex Moab, prævaluisse scilicet hostes, tulit secum septingentos viros educentes gladium, ut irrumperent ad regem Edom : et non potuerunt.
text_pt: Mas, vendo o rei dos moabitas que a peleja prevalecia contra ele, tomou consigo setecentos homens que sacavam espada, para romperem contra o rei de Edom, porém não puderam.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Μωαβ ὅτι ἐκραταίωσεν ὑπὲρ αὐτὸν ὁ πόλεμος καὶ ἔλαβεν μεθ' ἑαυτοῦ ἑπτακοσίους ἄνδρας ἐσπασμένους ῥομφαίαν διακόψαι πρὸς βασιλέα Εδωμ καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν

text_en: Then he took his eldest son, that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall: and there was great indignation in Israel , and presently they departed from him, and returned into their own country.
text_la: Arripiensque filium suum primogenitum, qui regnaturus erat pro eo, obtulit holocaustum super murum : et facta est indignatio magna in Israël, statimque recesserunt ab eo, et reversi sunt in terram suam.
text_pt: Então tomou a seu filho primogênito, que havia de reinar em seu lugar, e o ofereceu em holocausto sobre o muro; pelo que houve grande indignação em Israel; por isso retiraram-se dele, e voltaram para a sua terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν πρωτότοκον ὃς ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν αὐτὸν ὁλοκαύτωμα ἐπὶ τοῦ τείχους καὶ ἐγένετο μετάμελος μέγας ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἀπῆραν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς τὴν γῆν

text_en: Now a certain woman of the wives of the prophets , cried to Eliseus , saying: Your servant, my husband, is dead, and you know that your servant was one that feared God , and behold the creditor has come to take away my two sons to serve him.
text_la: Mulier autem quædam de uxoribus prophetarum clamabat ad Eliseum, dicens : Servus tuus vir meus mortuus est, et tu nosti quia servus tuus fuit timens Dominum : et ecce creditor venit ut tollat duos filios meos ad serviendum sibi.
text_pt: E uma mulher, das mulheres dos filhos dos profetas, clamou a Eliseu, dizendo: Meu marido, teu servo, morreu; e tu sabes que o teu servo temia ao SENHOR; e veio o credor, para levar os meus dois filhos para serem servos.
text_el: καὶ γυνὴ μία ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν προφητῶν ἐβόα πρὸς Ελισαιε λέγουσα ὁ δοῦλός σου ὁ ἀνήρ μου ἀπέθανεν καὶ σὺ ἔγνως ὅτι δοῦλος ἦν φοβούμενος τὸν κύριον καὶ ὁ δανιστὴς ἦλθεν λαβεῖν τοὺς δύο υἱούς μου ἑαυτῷ εἰς δούλους

text_en: And Eliseus said to her: What will you have me do for you? Tell me, what have you in your house? And she answered: I, your handmaid, have nothing in my house but a little oil, to anoint me.
text_la: Cui dixit Eliseus : Quid vis ut faciam tibi? dic mihi, quid habes in domo tua? At illa respondit : Non habeo ancilla tua quidquam in domo mea, nisi parum olei quo ungar.
text_pt: E Eliseu lhe disse: Que te hei de fazer? Dize-me que é o que tens em casa. E ela disse: Tua serva não tem nada em casa, senão uma botija de azeite.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε τί ποιήσω σοι ἀνάγγειλόν μοι τί ἐστίν σοι ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ ἡ δὲ εἶπεν οὐκ ἔστιν τῇ δούλῃ σου οὐθὲν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ ὅτι ἀλλ' ἢ ὃ ἀλείψομαι ἔλαιον

text_en: And he said to her: Go, borrow of all your neighbours empty vessels, not a few.
text_la: Cui ait : Vade, pete mutuo ab omnibus vicinis tuis vasa vacua non pauca,
text_pt: Então disse ele: Vai, pede emprestadas, de todos os teus vizinhos, vasilhas vazias, não poucas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτήν δεῦρο αἴτησον σαυτῇ σκεύη ἔξωθεν παρὰ πάντων τῶν γειτόνων σου σκεύη κενά μὴ ὀλιγώσῃς

text_en: And go in, and shut your door, when you are within, and your sons: and pour out thereof into all those vessels: and when they are full, take them away.
text_la: et ingredere, et claude ostium tuum cum intrinsecus fueris tu, et filii tui : et mitte inde in omnia vasa hæc, et cum plena fuerint, tolles.
text_pt: Então entra, e fecha a porta sobre ti, e sobre teus filhos, e deita o azeite em todas aquelas vasilhas, e põe à parte a que estiver cheia.
text_el: καὶ εἰσελεύσῃ καὶ ἀποκλείσεις τὴν θύραν κατὰ σοῦ καὶ κατὰ τῶν υἱῶν σου καὶ ἀποχεεῖς εἰς τὰ σκεύη ταῦτα καὶ τὸ πληρωθὲν ἀρεῖς

text_en: So the woman went, and shut the door upon her, and upon her sons: they brought her the vessels, and she poured in.
text_la: Ivit itaque mulier, et clausit ostium super se, et super filios suos : illi offerebant vasa, et illa infundebat.
text_pt: Partiu, pois, dele, e fechou a porta sobre si e sobre seus filhos; e eles lhe traziam as vasilhas, e ela as enchia.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν παρ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐποίησεν οὕτως καὶ ἀπέκλεισεν τὴν θύραν κατ' αὐτῆς καὶ κατὰ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτῆς αὐτοὶ προσήγγιζον πρὸς αὐτήν καὶ αὐτὴ ἐπέχεεν

text_en: And when the vessels were full, she said to her son: Bring me yet a vessel. And he answered: I have no more. And the oil stood.
text_la: Cumque plena fuissent vasa, dixit ad filium suum : Affer mihi adhuc vas. Et ille respondit : Non habeo. Stetitque oleum.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, cheias que foram as vasilhas, disse a seu filho: Traze-me ainda uma vasilha. Porém ele lhe disse: Não há mais vasilha alguma. Então o azeite parou.
text_el: ἕως ἐπλήσθησαν τὰ σκεύη καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῆς ἐγγίσατε ἔτι πρός με σκεῦος καὶ εἶπον αὐτῇ οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι σκεῦος καὶ ἔστη τὸ ἔλαιον

text_en: And she came, and told the man of God . And he said: Go, sell the oil, and pay your creditor: and you and your sons live of the rest.
text_la: Venit autem illa, et indicavit homini Dei. Et ille : Vade, inquit, vende oleum, et redde creditori tuo : tu autem, et filii tui vivite de reliquo.
text_pt: Então veio ela, e o fez saber ao homem de Deus; e disse ele: Vai, vende o azeite, e paga a tua dívida; e tu e teus filhos vivei do resto.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε δεῦρο καὶ ἀπόδου τὸ ἔλαιον καὶ ἀποτείσεις τοὺς τόκους σου καὶ σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου ζήσεσθε ἐν τῷ ἐπιλοίπῳ ἐλαίῳ

text_en: And there was a day when Eliseus passed by Sunam: now there was a great woman there, who detained him to eat bread: and as he passed often that way, he turned into her house to eat bread.
text_la: Facta est autem quædam dies, et transibat Eliseus per Sunam : erat autem ibi mulier magna, quæ tenuit eum ut comederet panem : cumque frequenter inde transiret, divertebat ad eam ut comederet panem.
text_pt: Sucedeu também um dia que, indo Eliseu a Suném, havia ali uma mulher importante, a qual o reteve para comer pão; e sucedeu que todas as vezes que passava por ali entrava para comer pão.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡμέρα καὶ διέβη Ελισαιε εἰς Σουμαν καὶ ἐκεῖ γυνὴ μεγάλη καὶ ἐκράτησεν αὐτὸν φαγεῖν ἄρτον καὶ ἐγένετο ἀφ' ἱκανοῦ τοῦ εἰσπορεύεσθαι αὐτὸν ἐξέκλινεν τοῦ ἐκεῖ φαγεῖν

text_en: And she said to her husband: I perceive that this is a holy man of God , who often passes by us.
text_la: Quæ dixit ad virum suum : Animadverto quod vir Dei sanctus est iste, qui transit per nos frequenter.
text_pt: E ela disse a seu marido: Eis que tenho observado que este que sempre passa por nós é um santo homem de Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἡ γυνὴ πρὸς τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς ἰδοὺ δὴ ἔγνων ὅτι ἄνθρωπος τοῦ θεοῦ ἅγιος οὗτος διαπορεύεται ἐφ' ἡμᾶς διὰ παντός

text_en: Let us, therefore, make him a little chamber, and put a little bed in it for him, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick, that when he comes to us he may abide there.
text_la: Faciamus ergo ei cœnaculum parvum, et ponamus ei in eo lectulum, et mensam, et sellam, et candelabrum, ut cum venerit ad nos, maneat ibi.
text_pt: Façamos-lhe, pois, um pequeno quarto junto ao muro, e ali lhe ponhamos uma cama, uma mesa, uma cadeira e um candeeiro; e há de ser que, vindo ele a nós, para ali se recolherá.
text_el: ποιήσωμεν δὴ αὐτῷ ὑπερῷον τόπον μικρὸν καὶ θῶμεν αὐτῷ ἐκεῖ κλίνην καὶ τράπεζαν καὶ δίφρον καὶ λυχνίαν καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαι πρὸς ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐκκλινεῖ ἐκεῖ

text_en: Now, there was a certain day, when he came, and turned into the chamber, and rested there.
text_la: Facta est ergo dies quædam, et veniens divertit in cœnaculum, et requievit ibi.
text_pt: E sucedeu que um dia ele chegou ali, e recolheu-se àquele quarto, e se deitou.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡμέρα καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐξέκλινεν εἰς τὸ ὑπερῷον καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐκεῖ

text_en: And he said to Giezi, his servant: Call this Sunamitess. And when he had called her, and she stood before him,
text_la: Dixitque ad Giezi puerum suum : Voca Sunamitidem istam. Qui cum vocasset eam, et illa stetisset coram eo,
text_pt: Então disse ao seu servo Geazi: Chama esta sunamita. E chamando-a ele, ela se pôs diante dele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Γιεζι τὸ παιδάριον αὐτοῦ κάλεσόν μοι τὴν Σωμανῖτιν ταύτην καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτήν καὶ ἔστη ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: he said to his servant: Say to her: Behold, you have diligently served us in all things; what will you have me to do for you? Have you any business, and will you, that I speak to the king, or to the general of the army? And she answered: I dwell in the midst of my own people.
text_la: dixit ad puerum suum : Loquere ad eam : Ecce, sedule in omnibus ministrasti nobis : quid vis ut faciam tibi? numquid habes negotium, et vis ut loquar regi, sive principi militiæ? Quæ respondit : In medio populi mei habito.
text_pt: Porque ele tinha falado a Geazi: Dize-lhe: Eis que tu nos tens tratado com todo o desvelo; que se há de fazer por ti? Haverá alguma coisa de que se fale por ti ao rei, ou ao capitão do exército? E disse ela: Eu habito no meio do meu povo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ εἰπὸν δὴ πρὸς αὐτήν ἰδοὺ ἐξέστησας ἡμῖν πᾶσαν τὴν ἔκστασιν ταύτην τί δεῖ ποιῆσαί σοι εἰ ἔστιν λόγος σοι πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ἢ πρὸς τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς δυνάμεως ἡ δὲ εἶπεν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ μου ἐγώ εἰμι οἰκῶ

text_en: And he said: What will she then that I do for her? And Giezi said: Do not ask, for she has no son, and her husband is old.
text_la: Et ait : Quid ergo vult ut faciam ei? Dixitque Giezi : Ne quæras : filium enim non habet, et vir ejus senex est.
text_pt: Então disse ele: Que se há de fazer por ela? E Geazi disse: Ora ela não tem filho, e seu marido é velho.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τί δεῖ ποιῆσαι αὐτῇ καὶ εἶπεν Γιεζι τὸ παιδάριον αὐτοῦ καὶ μάλα υἱὸς οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτῇ καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς πρεσβύτης

text_en: Then he bid him call her. And when she was called, and stood before the door,
text_la: Præcepit itaque ut vocaret eam : quæ cum vocata fuisset, et stetisset ante ostium,
text_pt: Por isso disse ele: Chama-a. E, chamando-a ele, ela se pôs à porta.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτήν καὶ ἔστη παρὰ τὴν θύραν

text_en: he said to her: At this time, and this same hour, if life be in company, you shall have a son in your womb. But she answered: Do not, I beseech you, my lord, you man of God , do not lie to your handmaid.
text_la: dixit ad eam : In tempore isto, et in hac eadem hora, si vita comes fuerit, habebis in utero filium. At illa respondit : Noli quæso, domine mi vir Dei, noli mentiri ancillæ tuæ.
text_pt: E ele disse: A este tempo determinado, segundo o tempo da vida, abraçarás um filho. E disse ela: Não, meu senhor, homem de Deus, não mintas à tua serva.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε πρὸς αὐτήν εἰς τὸν καιρὸν τοῦτον ὡς ἡ ὥρα ζῶσα σὺ περιειληφυῖα υἱόν ἡ δὲ εἶπεν μή κύριέ μου μὴ διαψεύσῃ τὴν δούλην σου

text_en: And the woman conceived, and brought forth a son in the time, and at the same hour that Eliseus had said.
text_la: Et concepit mulier, et peperit filium in tempore, et in hora eadem, qua dixerat Eliseus.
text_pt: E concebeu a mulher, e deu à luz um filho, no tempo determinado, no ano seguinte, segundo Eliseu lhe dissera.
text_el: καὶ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔλαβεν ἡ γυνὴ καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱὸν εἰς τὸν καιρὸν τοῦτον ὡς ἡ ὥρα ζῶσα ὡς ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτὴν Ελισαιε

text_en: And the child grew. And on a certain day, when he went out to his father to the reapers,
text_la: Crevit autem puer : et cum esset quædam dies, et egressus isset ad patrem suum, ad messores,
text_pt: E, crescendo o filho, sucedeu que um dia saiu para ter com seu pai, que estava com os segadores,
text_el: καὶ ἡδρύνθη τὸ παιδάριον καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα ἐξῆλθεν τὸ παιδάριον πρὸς τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ πρὸς τοὺς θερίζοντας

text_en: he said to his father: My head aches, my head aches. But he said to his servant. Take him, and carry him to his mother.
text_la: ait patri suo : Caput meum doleo, caput meum doleo. At ille dixit puero : Tolle, et duc eum ad matrem suam.
text_pt: E disse a seu pai: Ai, a minha cabeça! Ai, a minha cabeça! Então disse a um moço: Leva-o à sua mãe.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ τὴν κεφαλήν μου τὴν κεφαλήν μου καὶ εἶπεν τῷ παιδαρίῳ ἆρον αὐτὸν πρὸς τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, she sat him on her knees, until noon, and then he died.
text_la: Qui cum tulisset, et duxisset eum ad matrem suam, posuit eum illa super genua sua usque ad meridiem, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E ele o tomou, e o levou à sua mãe; e esteve sobre os seus joelhos até ao meio-dia, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἦρεν αὐτὸν πρὸς τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐπὶ τῶν γονάτων αὐτῆς ἕως μεσημβρίας καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And she went up, and laid him upon the bed of the man of God , and shut the door: and going out,
text_la: Ascendit autem, et collocavit eum super lectulum hominis Dei, et clausit ostium : et egressa,
text_pt: E subiu ela, e o deitou sobre a cama do homem de Deus; e fechou a porta, e saiu.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐκοίμισεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν κλίνην τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἀπέκλεισεν κατ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν

text_en: she called her husband, and said: Send with me, I beseech you, one of your servants, and an ass, that I may run to the man of God , and come again.
text_la: vocavit virum suum, et ait : Mitte mecum, obsecro, unum de pueris, et asinam, ut excurram usque ad hominem Dei, et revertar.
text_pt: E chamou a seu marido, e disse: Manda-me já um dos moços, e uma das jumentas, para que eu corra ao homem de Deus, e volte.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς καὶ εἶπεν ἀπόστειλον δή μοι ἓν τῶν παιδαρίων καὶ μίαν τῶν ὄνων καὶ δραμοῦμαι ἕως τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐπιστρέψω

text_en: And he said to her: Why do you go to him? To day is neither new moon nor sabbath . She answered: I will go.
text_la: Qui ait illi : Quam ob causam vadis ad eum? hodie non sunt calendæ, neque sabbatum. Quæ respondit : Vadam.
text_pt: E disse ele: Por que vais a ele hoje? Não é lua nova nem sábado. E ela disse: Tudo vai bem.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τί ὅτι σὺ πορεύῃ πρὸς αὐτὸν σήμερον οὐ νεομηνία οὐδὲ σάββατον ἡ δὲ εἶπεν εἰρήνη

text_en: And she saddled an ass, and commanded her servant: Drive, and make haste, make no stay in going: And do that which I bid you.
text_la: Stravitque asinam, et præcepit puero : Mina, et propera : ne mihi moram facias in eundo : et hoc age quod præcipio tibi.
text_pt: Então albardou a jumenta, e disse ao seu servo: Guia e anda, e não te detenhas no caminhar, senão quando eu to disser.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέσαξεν τὴν ὄνον καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τὸ παιδάριον αὐτῆς ἄγε πορεύου μὴ ἐπίσχῃς μοι τοῦ ἐπιβῆναι ὅτι ἐὰν εἴπω σοι

text_en: So she went forward, and came to the man of God , to mount Carmel : and when the man of God saw her coming towards, he said to Giezi, his servant: Behold that Sunamitess.
text_la: Profecta est igitur, et venit ad virum Dei in montem Carmeli : cumque vidisset eam vir Dei e contra, ait ad Giezi puerum suum : Ecce Sunamitis illa.
text_pt: Partiu ela, pois, e foi ao homem de Deus, ao monte Carmelo; e sucedeu que, vendo-a o homem de Deus de longe, disse a Geazi, seu servo: Eis aí a sunamita.
text_el: δεῦρο καὶ πορεύσῃ καὶ ἐλεύσῃ πρὸς τὸν ἄνθρωπον τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Καρμήλιον καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἶδεν Ελισαιε ἐρχομένην αὐτήν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Γιεζι τὸ παιδάριον αὐτοῦ ἰδοὺ δὴ ἡ Σωμανῖτις ἐκείνη

text_en: Go, therefore, to meet her, and say to her: Is all well with you, and with your husband, and with your son? And she answered: Well.
text_la: Vade ergo in occursum ejus, et dic ei : Recte ne agitur circa te, et circa virum tuum, et circa filium tuum? Quæ respondit : Recte.
text_pt: Agora, pois, corre-lhe ao encontro e dize-lhe: Vai bem contigo? Vai bem com teu marido? Vai bem com teu filho? E ela disse: Vai bem.
text_el: νῦν δράμε εἰς ἀπαντὴν αὐτῆς καὶ ἐρεῖς εἰ εἰρήνη σοι εἰ εἰρήνη τῷ ἀνδρί σου εἰ εἰρήνη τῷ παιδαρίῳ ἡ δὲ εἶπεν Εἰρήνη

text_en: And when she came to the man of God , to the mount, she caught hold on his feet: and Giezi came to remove her. And the man of God said: Let her alone for her soul is in anguish, and the Lord has hid it from me, and has not told me.
text_la: Cumque venisset ad virum Dei in montem, apprehendit pedes ejus : et accessit Giezi ut amoveret eam. Et ait homo Dei : Dimitte illam : anima enim ejus in amaritudine est, et Dominus celavit a me, et non indicavit mihi.
text_pt: Chegando ela, pois, ao homem de Deus, ao monte, pegou nos seus pés; mas chegou Geazi para retirá-la; disse porém o homem de Deus: Deixa-a, porque a sua alma está triste de amargura, e o Senhor me encobriu, e não me manifestou.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς Ελισαιε εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ ἐπελάβετο τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤγγισεν Γιεζι ἀπώσασθαι αὐτήν καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε ἄφες αὐτήν ὅτι ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῆς κατώδυνος αὐτῇ καὶ κύριος ἀπέκρυψεν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἀνήγγειλέν μοι

text_en: And she said to him: Did I ask a son of my lord? Did I not say to you: Do not deceive me?
text_la: Quæ dixit illi : Numquid petivi filium a domino meo? numquid non dixi tibi : Ne illudas me?
text_pt: E disse ela: Pedi eu a meu senhor algum filho? Não disse eu: Não me enganes?
text_el: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν μὴ ᾐτησάμην υἱὸν παρὰ τοῦ κυρίου μου οὐκ εἶπα οὐ πλανήσεις μετ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: Then he said to Giezi: Gird up your loins, and take my staff in your hand, and go. If any man meet you, salute him not: and if any man salute you, answer him not: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
text_la: Et ille ait ad Giezi : Accinge lumbos tuos, et tolle baculum meum in manu tua, et vade. Si occurrerit tibi homo, non salutes eum : et si salutaverit te quispiam, non respondeas illi : et pones baculum meum super faciem pueri.
text_pt: E ele disse a Geazi: Cinge os teus lombos, toma o meu bordão na tua mão, e vai; se encontrares alguém não o saúdes, e se alguém te saudar, não lhe respondas; e põe o meu bordão sobre o rosto do menino.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε τῷ Γιεζι ζῶσαι τὴν ὀσφύν σου καὶ λαβὲ τὴν βακτηρίαν μου ἐν τῇ χειρί σου καὶ δεῦρο ὅτι ἐὰν εὕρῃς ἄνδρα οὐκ εὐλογήσεις αὐτόν καὶ ἐὰν εὐλογήσῃ σε ἀνήρ οὐκ ἀποκριθήσῃ αὐτῷ καὶ ἐπιθήσεις τὴν βακτηρίαν μου ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τοῦ παιδαρίου

text_en: But the mother of the child said: As the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. He arose, therefore, and followed her.
text_la: Porro mater pueri ait : Vivit Dominus, et vivit anima tua, non dimittam te. Surrexit ergo, et secutus est eam.
text_pt: Porém disse a mãe do menino: Vive o Senhor, e vive a tua alma, que não te hei de deixar. Então ele se levantou, e a seguiu.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ παιδαρίου ζῇ κύριος καὶ ζῇ ἡ ψυχή σου εἰ ἐγκαταλείψω σε καὶ ἀνέστη Ελισαιε καὶ ἐπορεύθη ὀπίσω αὐτῆς

text_en: But Giezi had gone before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child, and there was no voice nor sense: and he returned to meet him, and told him, saying: The child is not risen.
text_la: Giezi autem præcesserat ante eos, et posuerat baculum super faciem pueri, et non erat vox, neque sensus : reversusque est in occursum ejus, et nuntiavit ei, dicens : Non surrexit puer.
text_pt: E Geazi passou adiante deles, e pôs o bordão sobre o rosto do menino; porém não havia nele voz nem sentido; e voltou a encontrar-se com ele, e lhe trouxe aviso, dizendo: O menino não despertou.
text_el: καὶ Γιεζι διῆλθεν ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπέθηκεν τὴν βακτηρίαν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τοῦ παιδαρίου καὶ οὐκ ἦν φωνὴ καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἀκρόασις καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν εἰς ἀπαντὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτῷ λέγων οὐκ ἠγέρθη τὸ παιδάριον

text_en: Eliseus , therefore, went into the house, and behold the child lay dead on his bed:
text_la: Ingressus est ergo Eliseus domum, et ecce puer mortuus jacebat in lectulo ejus:
text_pt: E, chegando Eliseu àquela casa, eis que o menino jazia morto sobre a sua cama.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Ελισαιε εἰς τὸν οἶκον καὶ ἰδοὺ τὸ παιδάριον τεθνηκὸς κεκοιμισμένον ἐπὶ τὴν κλίνην αὐτοῦ

text_en: And going in, he shut the door upon him, and upon the child, and prayed to the Lord .
text_la: ingressusque clausit ostium super se et super puerum, et oravit ad Dominum.
text_pt: Então entrou ele, e fechou a porta sobre eles ambos, e orou ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Ελισαιε εἰς τὸν οἶκον καὶ ἀπέκλεισεν τὴν θύραν κατὰ τῶν δύο ἑαυτῶν καὶ προσηύξατο πρὸς κύριον

text_en: And he went up, and lay upon the child: and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he bowed himself upon him, and the child's flesh grew warm.
text_la: Et ascendit, et incubuit super puerum : posuitque os suum super os ejus, et oculos suos super oculos ejus, et manus suas super manus ejus : et incurvavit se super eum, et calefacta est caro pueri.
text_pt: E subiu à cama e deitou-se sobre o menino, e, pondo a sua boca sobre a boca dele, e os seus olhos sobre os olhos dele, e as suas mãos sobre as mãos dele, se estendeu sobre ele; e a carne do menino aqueceu.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐπὶ τὸ παιδάριον καὶ ἔθηκεν τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ καὶ διέκαμψεν ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ διεθερμάνθη ἡ σὰρξ τοῦ παιδαρίου

text_en: Then he returned and walked in the house, once to and fro: and he went up, and lay upon him: and the child gaped seven times, and opened his eyes.
text_la: At ille reversus, deambulavit in domo, semel huc atque illuc : et ascendit, et incubuit super eum : et oscitavit puer septies, aperuitque oculos.
text_pt: Depois desceu, e andou naquela casa de uma parte para a outra, e tornou a subir, e se estendeu sobre ele, então o menino espirrou sete vezes, e abriu os olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν καὶ ἀνέβη καὶ συνέκαμψεν ἐπὶ τὸ παιδάριον ἕως ἑπτάκις καὶ ἤνοιξεν τὸ παιδάριον τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he called Giezi, and said to him: Call this Sunamitess. And she being called, went in to him: and he said: Take up your son.
text_la: At ille vocavit Giezi, et dixit ei : Voca Sunamitidem hanc. Quæ vocata, ingressa est ad eum. Qui ait : Tolle filium tuum.
text_pt: Então chamou a Geazi, e disse: Chama esta sunamita. E chamou-a, e veio a ele. E disse ele: Toma o teu filho.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεβόησεν Ελισαιε πρὸς Γιεζι καὶ εἶπεν κάλεσον τὴν Σωμανῖτιν ταύτην καὶ ἐκάλεσεν καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε λαβὲ τὸν υἱόν σου

text_en: She came and fell at his feet, and worshipped upon the ground: and took up her son, and went out.
text_la: Venit illa, et corruit ad pedes ejus, et adoravit super terram : tulitque filium suum, et egressa est.
text_pt: E entrou ela, e se prostrou a seus pés, e se inclinou à terra; e tomou o seu filho e saiu.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ἡ γυνὴ καὶ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ καὶ προσεκύνησεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξῆλθεν

text_en: And Eliseus returned to Galgal, and there was a famine in the land, and the sons of the prophets dwelt before him: And he said to one of his servants: Set on the great pot, and boil pottage for the sons of the prophets .
text_la: Et Eliseus reversus est in Galgala. Erat autem fames in terra, et filii prophetarum habitabant coram eo. Dixitque uni de pueris suis : Pone ollam grandem, et coque pulmentum filiis prophetarum.
text_pt: E, voltando Eliseu a Gilgal, havia fome naquela terra, e os filhos dos profetas estavam assentados na sua presença; e disse ao seu servo: Põe a panela grande ao lume, e faze um caldo de ervas para os filhos dos profetas.
text_el: καὶ Ελισαιε ἐπέστρεψεν εἰς Γαλγαλα καὶ ὁ λιμὸς ἐν τῇ γῇ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν προφητῶν ἐκάθηντο ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε τῷ παιδαρίῳ αὐτοῦ ἐπίστησον τὸν λέβητα τὸν μέγαν καὶ ἕψε ἕψεμα τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν προφητῶν

text_en: And one went out into the field to gather wild herbs: and he found something like a wild vine, and gathered of it wild gourds of the field, and filled his mantle, and coming back, he shred them into the pot of pottage; for he knew not what it was.
text_la: Et egressus est unus in agrum ut colligeret herbas agrestes : invenitque quasi vitem silvestrem, et collegit ex ea colocynthidas agri, et implevit pallium suum, et reversus concidit in ollam pulmenti : nesciebat enim quid esset.
text_pt: Então um deles saiu ao campo a apanhar ervas, e achou uma parra brava, e colheu dela enchendo a sua capa de colocíntidas; e veio, e as cortou na panela do caldo; porque não as conheciam.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἷς εἰς τὸν ἀγρὸν συλλέξαι αριωθ καὶ εὗρεν ἄμπελον ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ καὶ συνέλεξεν ἀπ' αὐτῆς τολύπην ἀγρίαν πλῆρες τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνέβαλεν εἰς τὸν λέβητα τοῦ ἑψέματος ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνωσαν

text_en: And they poured it out for their companions to eat: and when they had tasted of the pottage, they cried out, saying: Death is in the pot, O man of God . And they could not eat thereof.
text_la: Infuderunt ergo sociis ut comederent : cumque gustassent de coctione, clamaverunt, dicentes : Mors in olla, vir Dei. Et non potuerunt comedere.
text_pt: Assim deram de comer para os homens. E sucedeu que, comendo eles daquele caldo, clamaram e disseram: Homem de Deus, há morte na panela. Não puderam comer.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέχει τοῖς ἀνδράσιν φαγεῖν καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐσθίειν αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ ἑψήματος καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνεβόησαν καὶ εἶπον θάνατος ἐν τῷ λέβητι ἄνθρωπε τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο φαγεῖν

text_en: But he said: Bring some meal. And when they had brought it, he cast it into the pot, and said: Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was now no bitterness in the pot.
text_la: At ille : Afferte, inquit, farinam. Cumque tulissent, misit in ollam, et ait : Infunde turbæ, ut comedant. Et non fuit amplius quidquam amaritudinis in olla.
text_pt: Porém ele disse: Trazei farinha. E deitou-a na panela, e disse: Dai de comer ao povo. E já não havia mal nenhum na panela.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν λάβετε ἄλευρον καὶ ἐμβάλετε εἰς τὸν λέβητα καὶ εἶπεν Ελισαιε πρὸς Γιεζι τὸ παιδάριον ἔγχει τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἐσθιέτωσαν καὶ οὐκ ἐγενήθη ἔτι ἐκεῖ ῥῆμα πονηρὸν ἐν τῷ λέβητι

text_en: And a certain man came from Baalsalisa, bringing to the man of God , bread of the firstfruits , twenty loaves of barley, and new corn in his scrip. And he said: Give to the people, that they may eat.
text_la: Vir autem quidam venit de Baalsalisa deferens viro Dei panes primitiarum, viginti panes hordeaceos, et frumentum novum in pera sua. At ille dixit : Da populo, ut comedat.
text_pt: E um homem veio de Baal-Salisa, e trouxe ao homem de Deus pães das primícias, vinte pães de cevada, e espigas verdes na sua palha, e disse: Dá ao povo, para que coma.
text_el: καὶ ἀνὴρ διῆλθεν ἐκ Βαιθσαρισα καὶ ἤνεγκεν πρὸς τὸν ἄνθρωπον τοῦ θεοῦ πρωτογενημάτων εἴκοσι ἄρτους κριθίνους καὶ παλάθας καὶ εἶπεν δότε τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἐσθιέτωσαν

text_en: And his servant answered him: How much is this, that I should set it before a hundred men ? He said again: Give to the people, that they may eat: for thus says the Lord : They shall eat, and there shall be left.
text_la: Responditque ei minister ejus : Quantum est hoc, ut apponam centum viris? Rursum ille ait : Da populo, ut comedat : hæc enim dicit Dominus : Comedent, et supererit.
text_pt: Porém seu servo disse: Como hei de pôr isto diante de cem homens? E disse ele: Dá ao povo, para que coma; porque assim diz o Senhor: Comerão, e sobejará.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ λειτουργὸς αὐτοῦ τί δῶ τοῦτο ἐνώπιον ἑκατὸν ἀνδρῶν καὶ εἶπεν δὸς τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἐσθιέτωσαν ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος φάγονται καὶ καταλείψουσιν

text_en: So he set it before them: and they ate, and there was left, according to the word of the Lord .
text_la: Posuit itaque coram eis : qui comederunt, et superfuit juxta verbum Domini.
text_pt: Então lhos pôs diante, e comeram e ainda sobrou, conforme a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ κατέλιπον κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου

text_en: Naaman, general of the army, of the king of Syria , was a great man with his master, and honourable: for by him the Lord gave deliverance to Syria : and he was a valiant man , and rich, but a leper .
text_la: Naaman princeps militiæ regis Syriæ erat vir magnus apud dominum suum, et honoratus : per illum enim dedit Dominus salutem Syriæ : erat autem vir fortis et dives, sed leprosus.
text_pt: E Naamã, capitão do exército do rei da Síria, era um grande homem diante do seu SENHOR, e de muito respeito; porque por ele o SENHOR dera livramento aos sírios; e era este homem herói valoroso, porém leproso.
text_el: καὶ Ναιμαν ὁ ἄρχων τῆς δυνάμεως Συρίας ἦν ἀνὴρ μέγας ἐνώπιον τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ καὶ τεθαυμασμένος προσώπῳ ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἔδωκεν κύριος σωτηρίαν Συρίᾳ καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ ἦν δυνατὸς ἰσχύι λελεπρωμένος

text_en: Now there had gone out robbers from Syria , and had led away captive out of the land of Israel , a little maid, and she waited upon Naaman's wife.
text_la: Porro de Syria egressi fuerant latrunculi, et captivam duxerant de terra Israël puellam parvulam, quæ erat in obsequio uxoris Naaman:
text_pt: E saíram tropas da Síria, da terra de Israel, e levaram presa uma menina que ficou ao serviço da mulher de Naamã.
text_el: καὶ Συρία ἐξῆλθον μονόζωνοι καὶ ᾐχμαλώτευσαν ἐκ γῆς Ισραηλ νεάνιδα μικράν καὶ ἦν ἐνώπιον τῆς γυναικὸς Ναιμαν

text_en: And she said to her mistress: I wish my master had been with the prophet that is in Samaria : he would certainly have healed him of the leprosy which he has.
text_la: quæ ait ad dominam suam : Utinam fuisset dominus meus ad prophetam qui est in Samaria, profecto curasset eum a lepra quam habet.
text_pt: E disse esta à sua senhora: Antes o meu senhor estivesse diante do profeta que está em Samaria; ele o restauraria da sua lepra.
text_el: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν τῇ κυρίᾳ αὐτῆς ὄφελον ὁ κύριός μου ἐνώπιον τοῦ προφήτου τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ τότε ἀποσυνάξει αὐτὸν ἀπὸ τῆς λέπρας αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then Naaman went in to his lord, and told him, saying: Thus and thus said the girl from the land of Israel .
text_la: Ingressus est itaque Naaman ad dominum suum, et nuntiavit ei, dicens : Sic et sic locuta est puella de terra Israël.
text_pt: Então foi Naamã e notificou ao seu senhor, dizendo: Assim e assim falou a menina que é da terra de Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ κυρίῳ ἑαυτῆς καὶ εἶπεν οὕτως καὶ οὕτως ἐλάλησεν ἡ νεᾶνις ἡ ἐκ γῆς Ισραηλ

text_en: And the king of Syria said to him: Go; and I will send a letter to the king of Israel . And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment;
text_la: Dixitque ei rex Syriæ : Vade, et mittam litteras ad regem Israël. Qui cum profectus esset, et tulisset secum decem talenta argenti, et sex millia aureos, et decem mutatoria vestimentorum,
text_pt: Então disse o rei da Síria: Vai, anda, e enviarei uma carta ao rei de Israel. E foi, e tomou na sua mão dez talentos de prata, seis mil siclos de ouro e dez mudas de roupas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς Συρίας πρὸς Ναιμαν δεῦρο εἴσελθε καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ βιβλίον πρὸς βασιλέα Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἔλαβεν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα τάλαντα ἀργυρίου καὶ ἑξακισχιλίους χρυσοῦς καὶ δέκα ἀλλασσομένας στολάς

text_en: and brought the letter to the king of Israel , in these words: When you shall receive this letter , know that I have sent to you Naaman, my servant, that you may heal him of his leprosy .
text_la: detulit litteras ad regem Israël in hæc verba : Cum acceperis epistolam hanc, scito quod miserim ad te Naaman servum meum, ut cures eum a lepra sua.
text_pt: E levou a carta ao rei de Israel, dizendo: Logo, em chegando a ti esta carta, saibas que eu te enviei Naamã, meu servo, para que o cures da sua lepra.
text_el: καὶ ἤνεγκεν τὸ βιβλίον πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Ισραηλ λέγων καὶ νῦν ὡς ἂν ἔλθῃ τὸ βιβλίον τοῦτο πρὸς σέ ἰδοὺ ἀπέστειλα πρὸς σὲ Ναιμαν τὸν δοῦλόν μου καὶ ἀποσυνάξεις αὐτὸν ἀπὸ τῆς λέπρας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when the king of Israel had read the letter , he rent his garments, and said: Am I God , to be able to kill and give life, that this man has sent to me to heal a man of his leprosy ? mark, and see how he seeks occasions against me.
text_la: Cumque legisset rex Israël litteras, scidit vestimenta sua, et ait : Numquid deus ego sum, ut occidere possim et vivificare, quia iste misit ad me ut curem hominem a lepra sua? animadvertite, et videte quod occasiones quærat adversum me.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, lendo o rei de Israel a carta, rasgou as suas vestes, e disse: Sou eu Deus, para matar e para vivificar, para que este envie a mim um homem, para que eu o cure da sua lepra? Pelo que deveras notai, peço-vos, e vede que busca ocasião contra mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἀνέγνω βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ τὸ βιβλίον διέρρηξεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν μὴ θεὸς ἐγὼ τοῦ θανατῶσαι καὶ ζωοποιῆσαι ὅτι οὗτος ἀποστέλλει πρός με ἀποσυνάξαι ἄνδρα ἀπὸ τῆς λέπρας αὐτοῦ ὅτι πλὴν γνῶτε δὴ καὶ ἴδετε ὅτι προφασίζεται οὗτός με

text_en: And when Eliseus , the man of God , had heard this, to wit, that the king of Israel had rent his garments, he sent to him, saying: Why have you rent your garments? Let him come to me, and let him know that there is a prophet in Israel .
text_la: Quod cum audisset Eliseus vir Dei, scidisse videlicet regem Israël vestimenta sua, misit ad eum, dicens : Quare scidisti vestimenta tua? veniat ad me, et sciat esse prophetam in Israël.
text_pt: Sucedeu, porém, que, ouvindo Eliseu, homem de Deus, que o rei de Israel rasgara as suas vestes, mandou dizer ao rei: Por que rasgaste as tuas vestes? Deixa-o vir a mim, e saberá que há profeta em Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν Ελισαιε ὅτι διέρρηξεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ τὰ ἱμάτια ἑαυτοῦ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Ισραηλ λέγων ἵνα τί διέρρηξας τὰ ἱμάτιά σου ἐλθέτω δὴ πρός με Ναιμαν καὶ γνώτω ὅτι ἔστιν προφήτης ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: So Naaman came with his horses and chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Eliseus :
text_la: Venit ergo Naaman cum equis et curribus, et stetit ad ostium domus Elisei:
text_pt: Veio, pois, Naamã com os seus cavalos, e com o seu carro, e parou à porta da casa de Eliseu.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Ναιμαν ἐν ἵππῳ καὶ ἅρματι καὶ ἔστη ἐπὶ θύρας οἴκου Ελισαιε

text_en: And Eliseus sent a messenger to him, saying: Go, and wash seven times in the Jordan , and your flesh shall recover health, and you shall be clean.
text_la: misitque ad eum Eliseus nuntium, dicens : Vade, et lavare septies in Jordane, et recipiet sanitatem caro tua, atque mundaberis.
text_pt: Então Eliseu lhe mandou um mensageiro, dizendo: Vai, e lava-te sete vezes no Jordão, e a tua carne será curada e ficarás purificado.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ελισαιε ἄγγελον πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγων πορευθεὶς λοῦσαι ἑπτάκις ἐν τῷ Ιορδάνῃ καὶ ἐπιστρέψει ἡ σάρξ σού σοι καὶ καθαρισθήσῃ

text_en: Naaman was angry , and went away, saying: I thought he would have come out to me, and standing, would have invoked the name of the Lord his God , and touched with his hand the place of the leprosy , and healed me.
