text_la: Fuerunt igitur gentes istæ timentes quidem Dominum, sed nihilominus et idolis suis servientes : nam et filii eorum, et nepotes, sicut fecerunt patres sui, ita faciunt usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: Assim estas nações temiam ao Senhor e serviam as suas imagens de escultura; também seus filhos, e os filhos de seus filhos, como fizeram seus pais, assim fazem eles até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν τὰ ἔθνη ταῦτα φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον καὶ τοῖς γλυπτοῖς αὐτῶν ἦσαν δουλεύοντες καί γε οἱ υἱοὶ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτῶν καθὰ ἐποίησαν οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν ποιοῦσιν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: In the third year of Osee, the son of Ela, king of Israel , reigned Ezechias , the son of Achaz , king of Juda .
text_la: Anno tertio Osee filii Ela regis Israël, regnavit Ezechias filius Achaz regis Juda.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, no terceiro ano de Oséias, filho de Elá, rei de Israel, começou a reinar Ezequias, filho de Acaz, rei de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν ἔτει τρίτῳ τῷ Ωσηε υἱῷ Ηλα βασιλεῖ Ισραηλ ἐβασίλευσεν Εζεκιας υἱὸς Αχαζ βασιλέως Ιουδα

text_en: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign: and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem : the name of his mother was Abi, the daughter of Zacharias.
text_la: Viginti quinque annorum erat cum regnare cœpisset, et viginti novem annis regnavit in Jerusalem : nomen matris ejus Abi filia Zachariæ.
text_pt: Tinha vinte e cinco anos de idade quando começou a reinar, e vinte e nove anos reinou em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Abi, filha de Zacarias.
text_el: υἱὸς εἴκοσι καὶ πέντε ἐτῶν ἦν ἐν τῷ βασιλεύειν αὐτὸν καὶ εἴκοσι καὶ ἐννέα ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Αβου θυγάτηρ Ζαχαριου

text_en: And he did that which was good before the Lord , according to all that David , his father, had done:
text_la: Fecitque quod erat bonum coram Domino, juxta omnia quæ fecerat David pater ejus.
text_pt: E fez o que era reto aos olhos do Senhor, conforme tudo o que fizera Davi, seu pai.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ εὐθὲς ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς κυρίου κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν Δαυιδ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ

text_en: He destroyed the high places, and broke the statues in pieces, and cut down the groves, and broke the brazen serpent, which Moses had made: for till that time the children of Israel burnt incense to it: and he called its name Nohestan.
text_la: Ipse dissipavit excelsa, et contrivit statuas, et succidit lucos, confregitque serpentem æneum quem fecerat Moyses : siquidem usque ad illud tempus filii Israël adolebant ei incensum : vocavitque nomen ejus Nohestan.
text_pt: Ele tirou os altos, quebrou as estátuas, deitou abaixo os bosques, e fez em pedaços a serpente de metal que Moisés fizera; porquanto até àquele dia os filhos de Israel lhe queimavam incenso, e lhe chamaram Neustã.
text_el: αὐτὸς ἐξῆρεν τὰ ὑψηλὰ καὶ συνέτριψεν πάσας τὰς στήλας καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσεν τὰ ἄλση καὶ τὸν ὄφιν τὸν χαλκοῦν ὃν ἐποίησεν Μωυσῆς ὅτι ἕως τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐκείνων ἦσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ θυμιῶντες αὐτῷ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν Νεεσθαν

text_en: He trusted in the Lord , the God of Israel : so that after him there was none like him among all the kings of Juda , nor any of them that were before him:
text_la: In Domino Deo Israël speravit : itaque post eum non fuit similis ei de cunctis regibus Juda, sed neque in his qui ante eum fuerunt:
text_pt: No Senhor Deus de Israel confiou, de maneira que depois dele não houve quem lhe fosse semelhante entre todos os reis de Judá, nem entre os que foram antes dele.
text_el: ἐν κυρίῳ θεῷ Ισραηλ ἤλπισεν καὶ μετ' αὐτὸν οὐκ ἐγενήθη ὅμοιος αὐτῷ ἐν βασιλεῦσιν Ιουδα καὶ ἐν τοῖς γενομένοις ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he stuck to the Lord , and departed not from his steps, but kept his commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses .
text_la: et adhæsit Domino, et non recessit a vestigiis ejus, fecitque mandata ejus, quæ præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: Porque se chegou ao Senhor, não se apartou dele, e guardou os mandamentos que o Senhor tinha dado a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐκολλήθη τῷ κυρίῳ οὐκ ἀπέστη ὄπισθεν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐφύλαξεν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ὅσας ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῇ

text_en: Wherefore the Lord also was with him, and in all things, to which he went forth, he behaved himself wisely. And he rebelled against the king of the Assyrians , and served him not.
text_la: Unde et erat Dominus cum eo, et in cunctis ad quæ procedebat, sapienter se agebat. Rebellavit quoque contra regem Assyriorum, et non servivit ei.
text_pt: Assim foi o Senhor com ele; para onde quer que saía se conduzia com prudência; e se rebelou contra o rei da Assíria, e não o serviu.
text_el: καὶ ἦν κύριος μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐποίει συνῆκεν καὶ ἠθέτησεν ἐν τῷ βασιλεῖ Ἀσσυρίων καὶ οὐκ ἐδούλευσεν αὐτῷ

text_en: He smote the Philistines as far as Gaza , and all their borders, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
text_la: Ipse percussit Philisthæos usque ad Gazam, et omnes terminos eorum, a turre custodum usque ad civitatem munitam.
text_pt: Ele feriu os filisteus até Gaza, como também os seus termos, desde a torre dos atalaias até à cidade fortificada.
text_el: αὐτὸς ἐπάταξεν τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους ἕως Γάζης καὶ ἕως ὁρίου αὐτῆς ἀπὸ πύργου φυλασσόντων καὶ ἕως πόλεως ὀχυρᾶς

text_en: In the fourth year of King Ezechias , which was the seventh year of Osee, the son of Ela, king of Israel , Salmanasar, king of the Assyrians , came up to Samaria , and besieged it,
text_la: Anno quarto regis Ezechiæ, qui erat annus septimus Osee filii Ela regis Israël, ascendit Salmanasar rex Assyriorum in Samariam, et oppugnavit eam,
text_pt: E sucedeu, no quarto ano do rei Ezequias (que era o sétimo ano de Oséias, filho de Elá, rei de Israel), que Salmaneser, rei da Assíria, subiu contra Samaria, e a cercou.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ τετάρτῳ βασιλεῖ Εζεκια αὐτὸς ἐνιαυτὸς ὁ ἕβδομος τῷ Ωσηε υἱῷ Ηλα βασιλεῖ Ισραηλ ἀνέβη Σαλαμανασσαρ βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων ἐπὶ Σαμάρειαν καὶ ἐπολιόρκει ἐπ' αὐτήν

text_en: and took it. For after three years, in the sixth year of Ezechias , that is, in the ninth year of Osee, king of Israel , Samaria was taken:
text_la: et cepit. Nam post annos tres, anno sexto Ezechiæ, id est nono anno Osee regis Israël, capta est Samaria:
text_pt: E a tomaram ao fim de três anos, no ano sexto de Ezequias, que era o ano nono de Oséias, rei de Israel, quando tomaram Samaria.
text_el: καὶ κατελάβετο αὐτὴν ἀπὸ τέλους τριῶν ἐτῶν ἐν ἔτει ἕκτῳ τῷ Εζεκια αὐτὸς ἐνιαυτὸς ἔνατος τῷ Ωσηε βασιλεῖ Ισραηλ καὶ συνελήμφθη Σαμάρεια

text_en: And the king of the Assyrians carried away Israel into Assyria , and placed them in Hala, and in Habor , by the rivers of Gozan, in the cities of the Medes .
text_la: et transtulit rex Assyriorum Israël in Assyrios, collocavitque eos in Hala et in Habor fluviis Gozan in civitatibus Medorum:
text_pt: E o rei da Assíria transportou a Israel para a Assíria; e os fez levar a Hala e a Habor, junto ao rio de Gozã, e às cidades dos medos;
text_el: καὶ ἀπῴκισεν βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων τὴν Σαμάρειαν εἰς Ἀσσυρίους καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτοὺς ἐν Αλαε καὶ ἐν Αβωρ ποταμῷ Γωζαν καὶ Ορη Μήδων

text_en: Because they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord , their God , but transgressed his covenant: all that Moses , the servant of the Lord , commanded, they would not hear, nor do.
text_la: quia non audierunt vocem Domini Dei sui, sed prætergressi sunt pactum ejus : omnia quæ præceperat Moyses servus Domini non audierunt, neque fecerunt.
text_pt: Porquanto não obedeceram à voz do Senhor seu Deus, antes transgrediram a sua aliança; e tudo quanto Moisés, servo do Senhor, tinha ordenado, nem o ouviram nem o fizeram.
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν ὅτι οὐκ ἤκουσαν τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου θεοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ παρέβησαν τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς ὁ δοῦλος κυρίου καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησαν

text_en: In the fourteenth year of King Ezechias , Sennacherib, king of the Assyrians , came up against the fenced cities of Juda , and took them.
text_la: Anno quartodecimo regis Ezechiæ, ascendit Sennacherib rex Assyriorum ad universas civitates Juda munitas, et cepit eas.
text_pt: Porém no ano décimo quarto do rei Ezequias subiu Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, contra todas as cidades fortificadas de Judá, e as tomou.
text_el: καὶ τῷ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει βασιλεῖ Εζεκιου ἀνέβη Σενναχηριμ βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων ἐπὶ τὰς πόλεις Ιουδα τὰς ὀχυρὰς καὶ συνέλαβεν αὐτάς

text_en: Then Ezechias , king of Juda , sent messengers to the king of the Assyrians , to Lachis, saying: I have offended, depart from me: and all that you shall put upon me, I will bear. And the king of the Assyrians put a tax upon Ezechias , king of Juda , of three hundred talents of silver, and thirty talents of gold.
text_la: Tunc misit Ezechias rex Juda nuntios ad regem Assyriorum in Lachis, dicens : Peccavi : recede a me, et omne quod imposueris mihi, feram. Indixit itaque rex Assyriorum Ezechiæ regi Judæ trecenta talenta argenti, et triginta talenta auri.
text_pt: Então Ezequias, rei de Judá, enviou ao rei da Assíria, a Laquis, dizendo: Pequei; retira-te de mim; tudo o que me impuseres suportarei. Então o rei da Assíria impôs a Ezequias, rei de Judá, trezentos talentos de prata e trinta talentos de ouro.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Εζεκιας βασιλεὺς Ιουδα ἀγγέλους πρὸς βασιλέα Ἀσσυρίων εἰς Λαχις λέγων ἡμάρτηκα ἀποστράφητι ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ὃ ἐὰν ἐπιθῇς ἐπ' ἐμέ βαστάσω καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων ἐπὶ Εζεκιαν βασιλέα Ιουδα τριακόσια τάλαντα ἀργυρίου καὶ τριάκοντα τάλαντα χρυσίου

text_en: And Ezechias gave all the silver that was found in the house of the Lord , and in the king's treasures.
text_la: Deditque Ezechias omne argentum quod repertum fuerat in domo Domini et in thesauris regis.
text_pt: Assim deu Ezequias toda a prata que se achou na casa do Senhor e nos tesouros da casa do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν Εζεκιας πᾶν τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ εὑρεθὲν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου καὶ ἐν θησαυροῖς οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: At that time Ezechias broke the doors of the temple of the Lord , and the plates of gold which he had fastened on them, and gave them to the king of the Assyrians .
text_la: In tempore illo confregit Ezechias valvas templi Domini, et laminas auri quas ipse affixerat, et dedit eas regi Assyriorum.
text_pt: Naquele tempo cortou Ezequias o ouro das portas do templo do Senhor, e das ombreiras, de que ele, rei de Judá, as cobrira, e o deu ao rei da Assíria.
text_el: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ συνέκοψεν Εζεκιας τὰς θύρας ναοῦ κυρίου καὶ τὰ ἐστηριγμένα ἃ ἐχρύσωσεν Εζεκιας βασιλεὺς Ιουδα καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὰ βασιλεῖ Ἀσσυρίων

text_en: And the king of the Assyrians sent Tharthan, and Rabsaris, and Rabsaces, from Lachis, to King Ezechias , with a strong army, to Jerusalem : and they went up and came to Jerusalem , and they stood by the conduit of the upper pool , which is in the way of the fuller's field.
text_la: Misit autem rex Assyriorum Tharthan, et Rabsaris, et Rabsacen de Lachis ad regem Ezechiam cum manu valida Jerusalem : qui cum ascendissent, venerunt Jerusalem, et steterunt juxta aquæductum piscinæ superioris, quæ est in via Agrifullonis.
text_pt: Contudo enviou o rei da Assíria a Tartã, e a Rabe-Saris, e a Rabsaqué, de Laquis, com grande exército ao rei Ezequias, a Jerusalém; subiram, e vieram a Jerusalém. E, subindo e vindo eles, pararam ao pé do aqueduto da piscina superior, que está junto ao caminho do campo do lavandeiro.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων τὸν Θαρθαν καὶ τὸν Ραφις καὶ τὸν Ραψακην ἐκ Λαχις πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Εζεκιαν ἐν δυνάμει βαρείᾳ ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἀνέβησαν καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔστησαν ἐν τῷ ὑδραγωγῷ τῆς κολυμβήθρας τῆς ἄνω ἥ ἐστιν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ ἀγροῦ τοῦ γναφέως

text_en: And they called for the king: and there went out to them Eliacim, the son of Helcias, who was over the house, and Sobna, the scribe, and Joahe, the son of Asaph, the recorder.
text_la: Vocaveruntque regem : egressus est autem ad eos Eliacim filius Helciæ præpositus domus, et Sobna scriba, et Joahe filius Asaph a commentariis.
text_pt: E chamaram o rei; e saíram a eles Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias, o mordomo, e Sebna, o escrivão, e Joá, filho de Asafe, o cronista.
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησαν πρὸς Εζεκιαν καὶ ἐξῆλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν Ελιακιμ υἱὸς Χελκιου ὁ οἰκονόμος καὶ Σομνας ὁ γραμματεὺς καὶ Ιωας υἱὸς Ασαφ ὁ ἀναμιμνῄσκων

text_en: And Rabsaces said to them: Speak to Ezechias : Thus says the great king, the king of the Assyrians : What is this confidence, wherein you trust?
text_la: Dixitque ad eos Rabsaces : Loquimini Ezechiæ : Hæc dicit rex magnus, rex Assyriorum : Quæ est ista fiducia, qua niteris?
text_pt: E Rabsaqué lhes disse: Ora, dizei a Ezequias: Assim diz o grande rei, o rei da Assíria: Que confiança é esta em que te estribas?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Ραψακης εἴπατε δὴ πρὸς Εζεκιαν τάδε λέγει ὁ βασιλεὺς ὁ μέγας βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων τίς ἡ πεποίθησις αὕτη ἣν πέποιθας

text_en: Perhaps you have taken counsel, to prepare yourself for battle. On whom do you trust, that you dare to rebel?
text_la: forsitan inisti consilium, ut præpares te ad prælium. In quo confidis, ut audeas rebellare?
text_pt: Dizes tu (porém são palavras só de lábios): Há conselho e poder para a guerra. Em quem, pois, agora confias, que contra mim te rebelas?
text_el: εἶπας πλὴν λόγοι χειλέων βουλὴ καὶ δύναμις εἰς πόλεμον νῦν οὖν τίνι πεποιθὼς ἠθέτησας ἐν ἐμοί

text_en: Do you trust in Egypt a staff of a broken reed, upon which if a man lean, it will break and go into his hand, and pierce it? So is Pharao , king of Egypt , to all that trust in him.
text_la: an speras in baculo arundineo atque confracto Ægypto, super quem, si incubuerit homo, comminutus ingredietur manum ejus, et perforabit eam? sic est Pharao rex Ægypti omnibus qui confidunt in se.
text_pt: Eis que agora tu confias naquele bordão de cana quebrada, no Egito, no qual, se alguém se encostar, entrar-lhe-á pela mão e a furará; assim é Faraó, rei do Egito, para com todos os que nele confiam.
text_el: νῦν ἰδοὺ πέποιθας σαυτῷ ἐπὶ τὴν ῥάβδον τὴν καλαμίνην τὴν τεθλασμένην ταύτην ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον ὃς ἂν στηριχθῇ ἀνὴρ ἐπ' αὐτήν καὶ εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ καὶ τρήσει αὐτήν οὕτως Φαραω βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου πᾶσιν τοῖς πεποιθόσιν ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: But if you say to me: We trust in the Lord , our God : is it not he, whose high places and altars Ezechias has taken away: and has commanded Juda and Jerusalem : You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem ?
text_la: Quod si dixeritis mihi : In Domino Deo nostro habemus fiduciam : nonne iste est, cujus abstulit Ezechias excelsa et altaria, et præcepit Judæ et Jerusalem : Ante altare hoc adorabitis in Jerusalem?
text_pt: Se, porém, me disserdes: No Senhor nosso Deus confiamos; porventura não é esse aquele cujos altos e cujos altares Ezequias tirou, dizendo a Judá e a Jerusalém: Perante este altar vos inclinareis em Jerusalém?
text_el: καὶ ὅτι εἶπας πρός με ἐπὶ κύριον θεὸν πεποίθαμεν οὐχὶ αὐτὸς οὗτος οὗ ἀπέστησεν Εζεκιας τὰ ὑψηλὰ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θυσιαστήρια αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Ιουδα καὶ τῇ Ιερουσαλημ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τούτου προσκυνήσετε ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Now therefore come over to my master, the king of the Assyrians , and I will give you two thousand horses, and see whether you be able to have riders for them.
text_la: Nunc igitur transite ad dominum meum regem Assyriorum, et dabo vobis duo millia equorum, et videte an habere valeatis ascensores eorum.
text_pt: Ora, pois, dá agora reféns ao meu senhor, o rei da Assíria, e dar-te-ei dois mil cavalos, se tu puderes dar cavaleiros para eles.
text_el: καὶ νῦν μίχθητε δὴ τῷ κυρίῳ μου βασιλεῖ Ἀσσυρίων καὶ δώσω σοι δισχιλίους ἵππους εἰ δυνήσῃ δοῦναι σεαυτῷ ἐπιβάτας ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And how can you stand against one lord of the least of my master's servants? Do you trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
text_la: Et quomodo potestis resistere ante unum satrapam de servis domini mei minimis? an fiduciam habes in Ægypto propter currus et equites?
text_pt: Como, pois, farias virar o rosto de um só capitão dos menores servos de meu senhor, quando tu confias no Egito, por causa dos carros e cavaleiros?
text_el: καὶ πῶς ἀποστρέψεις τὸ πρόσωπον τοπάρχου ἑνὸς τῶν δούλων τοῦ κυρίου μου τῶν ἐλαχίστων καὶ ἤλπισας σαυτῷ ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον εἰς ἅρματα καὶ ἱππεῖς

text_en: Is it without the will of the Lord that I have come up to this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me: Go up to this land, and destroy it.
text_la: Numquid sine Domini voluntate ascendi ad locum istum, ut demolirer eum? Dominus dixit mihi : Ascende ad terram hanc, et demolire eam.
text_pt: Agora, pois, subi eu porventura sem o Senhor contra este lugar, para o destruir? O Senhor me disse: Sobe contra esta terra, e destrói-a.
text_el: καὶ νῦν μὴ ἄνευ κυρίου ἀνέβημεν ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τοῦτον τοῦ διαφθεῖραι αὐτόν κύριος εἶπεν πρός με ἀνάβηθι ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ διάφθειρον αὐτήν

text_en: Then Eliacim, the son of Helcias, and Sobna, and Joahe, said to Rabsaces: We pray you, speak to us, your servants, in Syriac : for we understand that tongue: and speak not to us in the Jews' language , in the hearing of the people that are upon the wall.
text_la: Dixerunt autem Eliacim filius Helciæ, et Sobna, et Joahe Rabsaci : Precamur ut loquaris nobis servis tuis syriace : siquidem intelligimus hanc linguam : et non loquaris nobis judaice, audiente populo qui est super murum.
text_pt: Então disse Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias, e Sebna e Joá, a Rabsaqué: Rogamos-te que fales aos teus servos em siríaco; porque bem o entendemos; e não nos fales em judaico, aos ouvidos do povo que está em cima do muro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ελιακιμ υἱὸς Χελκιου καὶ Σομνας καὶ Ιωας πρὸς Ραψακην λάλησον δὴ πρὸς τοὺς παῖδάς σου Συριστί ὅτι ἀκούομεν ἡμεῖς καὶ οὐ λαλήσεις μεθ' ἡμῶν Ιουδαϊστί καὶ ἵνα τί λαλεῖς ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ τείχους

text_en: And Rabsaces answered them, saying: Hath my master sent me to your master, and to you, to speak these words, and not rather to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their urine with you?
text_la: Responditque eis Rabsaces, dicens : Numquid ad dominum tuum, et ad te misit me dominus meus, ut loquerer sermones hos, et non potius ad viros qui sedent super murum, ut comedant stercora sua, et bibant urinam suam vobiscum?
text_pt: Porém Rabsaqué lhes disse: Porventura mandou-me meu senhor somente a teu senhor e a ti, para falar estas palavras e não antes aos homens, que estão sentados em cima do muro, para que juntamente convosco comam o seu excremento e bebam a sua urina?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Ραψακης μὴ ἐπὶ τὸν κύριόν σου καὶ πρὸς σὲ ἀπέστειλέν με ὁ κύριός μου λαλῆσαι τοὺς λόγους τούτους οὐχὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄνδρας τοὺς καθημένους ἐπὶ τοῦ τείχους τοῦ φαγεῖν τὴν κόπρον αὐτῶν καὶ πιεῖν τὸ οὖρον αὐτῶν μεθ' ὑμῶν ἅμα

text_en: Then Rabsaces stood, and cried out with a loud voice in the Jews' language , and said: Hear the word of the great king, the king of the Assyrians .
text_la: Stetit itaque Rabsaces, et exclamavit voce magna judaice, et ait : Audite verba regis magni, regis Assyriorum.
text_pt: Rabsaqué, pois, se pôs em pé, e clamou em alta voz em judaico, e respondeu, dizendo: Ouvi a palavra do grande rei, do rei da Assíria.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη Ραψακης καὶ ἐβόησεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Ιουδαϊστὶ καὶ ἐλάλησεν καὶ εἶπεν ἀκούσατε τοὺς λόγους τοῦ μεγάλου βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων

text_en: Thus says the king: Let not Ezechias deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of my hand.
text_la: Hæc dicit rex : Non vos seducat Ezechias : non enim poterit eruere vos de manu mea:
text_pt: Assim diz o rei: Não vos engane Ezequias; porque não vos poderá livrar da sua mão;
text_el: τάδε λέγει ὁ βασιλεύς μὴ ἐπαιρέτω ὑμᾶς Εζεκιας λόγοις ὅτι οὐ μὴ δύνηται ὑμᾶς ἐξελέσθαι ἐκ χειρός μου

text_en: Neither let him make you trust in the Lord , saying: The Lord will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of the Assyrians .
text_la: neque fiduciam vobis tribuat super Dominum, dicens : Eruens liberabit nos Dominus, et non tradetur civitas hæc in manu regis Assyriorum.
text_pt: Nem tampouco vos faça Ezequias confiar no Senhor, dizendo: Certamente nos livrará o Senhor, e esta cidade não será entregue na mão do rei da Assíria.
text_el: καὶ μὴ ἐπελπιζέτω ὑμᾶς Εζεκιας πρὸς κύριον λέγων ἐξαιρούμενος ἐξελεῖται ἡμᾶς κύριος οὐ μὴ παραδοθῇ ἡ πόλις αὕτη ἐν χειρὶ βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων

text_en: Do not hearken to Ezechias . For thus says the king of the Assyrians : Do with me that which is for your advantage, and come out to me: and every man of you shall eat of his own vineyard, and of his own fig tree: and you shall drink water of your own cisterns ,
text_la: Nolite audire Ezechiam. Hæc enim dicit rex Assyriorum : Facite mecum quod vobis est utile, et egredimini ad me : et comedet unusquisque de vinea sua, et de ficu sua : et bibetis aquas de cisternis vestris,
text_pt: Não deis ouvidos a Ezequias; porque assim diz o rei da Assíria: Contratai comigo por presentes, e saí a mim, e coma cada um da sua vide e da sua figueira, e beba cada um a água da sua cisterna;
text_el: μὴ ἀκούετε Εζεκιου ὅτι τάδε λέγει ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων ποιήσατε μετ' ἐμοῦ εὐλογίαν καὶ ἐξέλθατε πρός με καὶ πίεται ἀνὴρ τὴν ἄμπελον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνὴρ τὴν συκῆν αὐτοῦ φάγεται καὶ πίεται ὕδωρ τοῦ λάκκου αὐτοῦ

text_en: till I come, and take you away, to a land, like to your own land, a fruitful land, and plentiful in wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olives, and oil, and honey, and you shall live, and not die. Hearken not to Ezechias , who deceives you, saying: The Lord will deliver us.
text_la: donec veniam, et transferam vos in terram quæ similis est terræ vestræ, in terram fructiferam, et fertilem vini, terram panis et vinearum, terram olivarum et olei ac mellis : et vivetis, et non moriemini. Nolite audire Ezechiam, qui vos decipit, dicens : Dominus liberabit nos.
text_pt: Até que eu venha, e vos leve para uma terra como a vossa, terra de trigo e de mosto, terra de pão e de vinhas, terra de oliveiras, de azeite e de mel; e assim vivereis, e não morrereis; e não deis ouvidos a Ezequias; porque vos incita, dizendo: O Senhor nos livrará.
text_el: ἕως ἔλθω καὶ λάβω ὑμᾶς εἰς γῆν ὡς γῆ ὑμῶν γῆ σίτου καὶ οἴνου καὶ ἄρτου καὶ ἀμπελώνων γῆ ἐλαίας ἐλαίου καὶ μέλιτος καὶ ζήσετε καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνητε καὶ μὴ ἀκούετε Εζεκιου ὅτι ἀπατᾷ ὑμᾶς λέγων κύριος ῥύσεται ἡμᾶς

text_en: Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their land from the hand of the king of Assyria ?
text_la: Numquid liberaverunt dii gentium terram suam de manu regis Assyriorum?
text_pt: Porventura os deuses das nações puderam livrar, cada um a sua terra, das mãos do rei da Assíria?
text_el: μὴ ῥυόμενοι ἐρρύσαντο οἱ θεοὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ χώραν ἐκ χειρὸς βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων

text_en: Where is the god of Emath, and of Arphad? Where is the god of Sepharvaim, of Ana, and of Ava? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
text_la: ubi est deus Emath, et Arphad? ubi est deus Sepharvaim, Ana, et Ava? numquid liberaverunt Samariam de manu mea?
text_pt: Que é feito dos deuses de Hamate e de Arpade? Que é feito dos deuses de Sefarvaim, Hena e Iva? Porventura livraram a Samaria da minha mão?
text_el: ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς Αιμαθ καὶ Αρφαδ ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς Σεπφαρουαιν καὶ ὅτι ἐξείλαντο Σαμάρειαν ἐκ χειρός μου

text_en: Who are they among all the gods of the nations that have delivered their country out of my hand, that the Lord may deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
text_la: Quinam illi sunt in universis diis terrarum, qui eruerunt regionem suam de manu mea, ut possit eruere Dominus Jerusalem de manu mea?
text_pt: Quais são eles, dentre todos os deuses das terras, que livraram a sua terra da minha mão, para que o Senhor livrasse a Jerusalém da minha mão?
text_el: τίς ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς θεοῖς τῶν γαιῶν οἳ ἐξείλαντο τὰς γᾶς αὐτῶν ἐκ χειρός μου ὅτι ἐξελεῖται κύριος τὴν Ιερουσαλημ ἐκ χειρός μου

text_en: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for they had received commandment from the king that they should not answer him.
text_la: Tacuit itaque populus, et non respondit ei quidquam : siquidem præceptum regis acceperant ut non responderent ei.
text_pt: Porém calou-se o povo, e não lhe respondeu uma só palavra; porque mandado do rei havia, dizendo: Não lhe respondereis.
text_el: καὶ ἐκώφευσαν καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ λόγον ὅτι ἐντολὴ τοῦ βασιλέως λέγων οὐκ ἀποκριθήσεσθε αὐτῷ

text_en: And Eliacim, the son of Helcias, who was over the house, and Sobna, the scribe, and Joahe, the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Ezechias , with their garments rent, and told him the words of Rabsaces.
text_la: Venitque Eliacim filius Helciæ, præpositus domus, et Sobna scriba, et Joahe filius Asaph a commentariis ad Ezechiam scissis vestibus, et nuntiaverunt ei verba Rabsacis.
text_pt: Então Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias, o mordomo, e Sebna, o escrivão, e Joá, filho de Asafe, o cronista, vieram a Ezequias com as vestes rasgadas, e lhe fizeram saber as palavras de Rabsaqué.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Ελιακιμ υἱὸς Χελκιου ὁ οἰκονόμος καὶ Σομνας ὁ γραμματεὺς καὶ Ιωας υἱὸς Ασαφ ὁ ἀναμιμνῄσκων πρὸς Εζεκιαν διερρηχότες τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ ἀνήγγειλαν αὐτῷ τοὺς λόγους Ραψακου

text_en: And when King Ezechias heard these words, he rent his garments, and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the Lord .
text_la: Quæ cum audisset Ezechias rex, scidit vestimenta sua, et opertus est sacco, ingressusque est domum Domini.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, tendo Ezequias ouvido isto, rasgou as suas vestes, e se cobriu de saco, e entrou na casa do SENHOR.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Εζεκιας καὶ διέρρηξεν τὰ ἱμάτια ἑαυτοῦ καὶ περιεβάλετο σάκκον καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς οἶκον κυρίου

text_en: And he sent Eliacim, who was over the house, and Sobna, the scribe, and the ancients of the priests , covered with sackcloths , to Isaiah, the prophet , the son of Amos.
text_la: Et misit Eliacim præpositum domus, et Sobnam scribam, et senes de sacerdotibus, opertos saccis, ad Isaiam prophetam filium Amos.
text_pt: Então enviou a Eliaquim, o mordomo, e a Sebna, o escrivão, e os anciãos dos sacerdotes, cobertos de sacos, ao profeta Isaías, filho de Amós.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ελιακιμ τὸν οἰκονόμον καὶ Σομναν τὸν γραμματέα καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους τῶν ἱερέων περιβεβλημένους σάκκους πρὸς Ησαιαν τὸν προφήτην υἱὸν Αμως

text_en: And they said to him: Thus says Ezechias : This day is a day of tribulation, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy : the children have come to the birth, and the woman in travail has not strength.
text_la: Qui dixerunt : Hæc dicit Ezechias : Dies tribulationis, et increpationis, et blasphemiæ dies iste : venerunt filii usque ad partum, et vires non habet parturiens.
text_pt: E disseram-lhe: Assim diz Ezequias: Este dia é dia de angústia, de vituperação e de blasfêmia; porque os filhos chegaram ao parto, e não há força para dá-los à luz.
text_el: καὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτόν τάδε λέγει Εζεκιας ἡμέρα θλίψεως καὶ ἐλεγμοῦ καὶ παροργισμοῦ ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη ὅτι ἦλθον υἱοὶ ἕως ὠδίνων καὶ ἰσχὺς οὐκ ἔστιν τῇ τικτούσῃ

text_en: It may be the Lord , your God , will hear all the words of Rabsaces, whom the king of the Assyrians , his master, has sent to reproach the living God , and to reprove with words, which the Lord , your God , has heard: and offer prayer for the remnants that are found.
text_la: Si forte audiat Dominus Deus tuus universa verba Rabsacis, quem misit rex Assyriorum dominus suus ut exprobraret Deum viventem et argueret verbis, quæ audivit Dominus Deus tuus : et fac orationem pro reliquiis quæ repertæ sunt.
text_pt: Bem pode ser que o SENHOR teu Deus ouça todas as palavras de Rabsaqué, a quem enviou o seu senhor, o rei da Assíria, para afrontar o Deus vivo, e para vituperá-lo com as palavras que o SENHOR teu Deus tem ouvido; faze, pois, oração pelo restante que subsiste.
text_el: εἴ πως εἰσακούσεται κύριος ὁ θεός σου πάντας τοὺς λόγους Ραψακου ὃν ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ ὀνειδίζειν θεὸν ζῶντα καὶ βλασφημεῖν ἐν λόγοις οἷς ἤκουσεν κύριος ὁ θεός σου καὶ λήμψῃ προσευχὴν περὶ τοῦ λείμματος τοῦ εὑρισκομένου

text_en: So the servants of King Ezechias came to Isaiah .
text_la: Venerunt ergo servi regis Ezechiæ ad Isaiam.
text_pt: E os servos do rei Ezequias foram a Isaías.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον οἱ παῖδες τοῦ βασιλέως Εζεκιου πρὸς Ησαιαν

text_en: And Isaiah said to them: Thus shall you say to your master: Thus says the Lord : Be not afraid for the words which you have heard, with which the servants of the king of the Assyrians have blasphemed me.
text_la: Dixitque eis Isaias : Hæc dicetis domino vestro : Hæc dicit Dominus : Noli timere a facie sermonum quos audisti, quibus blasphemaverunt pueri regis Assyriorum me.
text_pt: E Isaías lhes disse: Assim direis a vosso senhor: Assim diz o SENHOR: Não temas as palavras que ouviste, com as quais os servos do rei da Assíria me blasfemaram.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ησαιας τάδε ἐρεῖτε πρὸς τὸν κύριον ὑμῶν τάδε λέγει κύριος μὴ φοβηθῇς ἀπὸ τῶν λόγων ὧν ἤκουσας ὧν ἐβλασφήμησαν τὰ παιδάρια βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων

text_en: Behold I will send a spirit upon him, and he shall hear a message, and shall return into his own country, and I will make him fall by the sword in his own country.
text_la: Ecce ego immittam ei spiritum, et audiet nuntium, et revertetur in terram suam, et dejiciam eum gladio in terra sua.
text_pt: Eis que porei nele um espírito, e ele ouvirá um rumor, e voltará para a sua terra; à espada o farei cair na sua terra.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ δίδωμι ἐν αὐτῷ πνεῦμα καὶ ἀκούσεται ἀγγελίαν καὶ ἀποστραφήσεται εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ καὶ καταβαλῶ αὐτὸν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Rabsaces returned, and found the king of the Assyrians besieging Lobna: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachis.
text_la: Reversus est ergo Rabsaces, et invenit regem Assyriorum expugnantem Lobnam : audierat enim quod recessisset de Lachis.
text_pt: Voltou, pois, Rabsaqué, e achou o rei da Assíria pelejando contra Libna, porque tinha ouvido que o rei havia partido de Laquis.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Ραψακης καὶ εὗρεν τὸν βασιλέα Ἀσσυρίων πολεμοῦντα ἐπὶ Λομνα ὅτι ἤκουσεν ὅτι ἀπῆρεν ἀπὸ Λαχις

text_en: And when he heard of Tharaca, king of Ethiopia : Behold, he has come out to fight with you: and was going against him, he sent messengers to Ezechias , saying:
text_la: Cumque audisset de Tharaca rege Æthiopiæ, dicentes : Ecce egressus est ut pugnet adversum te : et iret contra eum, misit nuntios ad Ezechiam, dicens:
text_pt: E, ouvindo ele dizer de Tiraca, rei da Etiópia: Eis que saiu para te fazer guerra; tornou a enviar mensageiros a Ezequias, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν περὶ Θαρακα βασιλέως Αἰθιόπων λέγων ἰδοὺ ἐξῆλθεν πολεμεῖν μετὰ σοῦ καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους πρὸς Εζεκιαν λέγων

text_en: Thus shall you say to Ezechias , king of Juda : Let not your God deceive you, in whom you trust: and do not say: Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hands of the king of the Assyrians .
text_la: Hæc dicite Ezechiæ regi Juda : Non te seducat Deus tuus in quo habes fiduciam, neque dicas : Non tradetur Jerusalem in manus regis Assyriorum.
text_pt: Assim falareis a Ezequias, rei de Judá: Não te engane o teu Deus, em quem confias, dizendo: Jerusalém não será entregue na mão do rei da Assíria.
text_el: μὴ ἐπαιρέτω σε ὁ θεός σου ἐφ' ᾧ σὺ πέποιθας ἐπ' αὐτῷ λέγων οὐ μὴ παραδοθῇ Ιερουσαλημ εἰς χεῖρας βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων

text_en: Behold, you have heard what the kings of the Assyrians have done to all countries, how they have laid them waste: and can you alone be delivered?
text_la: Tu enim ipse audisti quæ fecerunt reges Assyriorum universis terris, quomodo vastaverunt eas : num ergo solus poteris liberari?
text_pt: Eis que já tens ouvido o que fizeram os reis da Assíria a todas as terras, destruindo-as totalmente; e tu, te livrarás?
text_el: ἰδοὺ σὺ ἤκουσας πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησαν βασιλεῖς Ἀσσυρίων πάσαις ταῖς γαῖς τοῦ ἀναθεματίσαι αὐτάς καὶ σὺ ῥυσθήσῃ

text_en: Have the gods of the nations delivered any of them, whom my fathers have destroyed, to wit, Gozan, and Haran , and Reseph, and the children of Eden, that were in Thelassar?
text_la: Numquid liberaverunt dii gentium singulos quos vastaverunt patres mei, Gozan videlicet, et Haran, et Reseph, et filios Eden qui erant in Thelassar?
text_pt: Porventura as livraram os deuses das nações, a quem meus pais destruíram, como a Gozã, a Harã, a Rezefe, e aos filhos de Éden, que estavam em Telassar?
text_el: μὴ ἐξείλαντο αὐτοὺς οἱ θεοὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν οὓς διέφθειραν οἱ πατέρες μου τήν τε Γωζαν καὶ τὴν Χαρραν καὶ Ραφες καὶ υἱοὺς Εδεμ τοὺς ἐν Θαεσθεν

text_en: Where is the king of Emath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, and of Ana, and of Ava?
text_la: ubi est rex Emath, et rex Arphad, et rex civitatis Sepharvaim, Ana, et Ava?
text_pt: Que é feito do rei de Hamate, do rei de Arpade, e do rei da cidade de Sefarvaim, Hena e Iva?
text_el: ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ βασιλεὺς Αιμαθ καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς Αρφαδ καὶ ποῦ ἐστιν Σεπφαρουαιν Ανα καὶ Αυα

text_en: And when Ezechias had received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and had read it, he went up to the house of the Lord , and spread it before the Lord ,
text_la: Itaque cum accepisset Ezechias litteras de manu nuntiorum, et legisset eas, ascendit in domum Domini, et expandit eas coram Domino,
text_pt: Recebendo, pois, Ezequias as cartas das mãos dos mensageiros e lendo-as, subiu à casa do Senhor; e Ezequias as estendeu perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Εζεκιας τὰ βιβλία ἐκ χειρὸς τῶν ἀγγέλων καὶ ἀνέγνω αὐτά καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς οἶκον κυρίου καὶ ἀνέπτυξεν αὐτὰ Εζεκιας ἐναντίον κυρίου

text_en: and he prayed in his sight, saying: O Lord God of Israel , who sits upon the cherubims , you alone are the God of all the kings of the earth: you made heaven and earth:
text_la: et oravit in conspectu ejus, dicens : Domine Deus Israël, qui sedes super cherubim, tu es Deus solus regum omnium terræ : tu fecisti cælum et terram.
text_pt: E orou Ezequias perante o Senhor e disse: Ó Senhor Deus de Israel, que habitas entre os querubins, tu mesmo, só tu és Deus de todos os reinos da terra; tu fizeste os céus e a terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριε ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῶν χερουβιν σὺ εἶ ὁ θεὸς μόνος ἐν πάσαις ταῖς βασιλείαις τῆς γῆς σὺ ἐποίησας τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: Incline your ear, and hear: open, O Lord , your eyes and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to upbraid unto us the living God .
text_la: Inclina aurem tuam, et audi : aperi, Domine, oculos tuos, et vide : audi omnia verba Sennacherib, qui misit ut exprobraret nobis Deum viventem.
text_pt: Inclina, Senhor, o teu ouvido, e ouve; abre, Senhor, os teus olhos, e olha; e ouve as palavras de Senaqueribe, que enviou a este, para afrontar o Deus vivo.
text_el: κλῖνον κύριε τὸ οὖς σου καὶ ἄκουσον ἄνοιξον κύριε τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου καὶ ἰδὲ καὶ ἄκουσον τοὺς λόγους Σενναχηριμ οὓς ἀπέστειλεν ὀνειδίζειν θεὸν ζῶντα

text_en: Of a truth , O Lord , the kings of the Assyrians have destroyed nations, and the lands of them all.
text_la: Vere, Domine, dissipaverunt reges Assyriorum gentes, et terras omnium.
text_pt: Verdade é, ó Senhor, que os reis da Assíria assolaram as nações e as suas terras.
text_el: ὅτι ἀληθείᾳ κύριε ἠρήμωσαν βασιλεῖς Ἀσσυρίων τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: And they have cast their gods into the fire: for they were not gods, but the work of men's hands, of wood and stone, and they destroyed them.
text_la: Et miserunt deos eorum in ignem : non enim erant dii, sed opera manuum hominum, ex ligno et lapide : et perdiderunt eos.
text_pt: E lançaram os seus deuses no fogo; porquanto não eram deuses, mas obra de mãos de homens, madeira e pedra; por isso os destruíram.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν τοὺς θεοὺς αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ πῦρ ὅτι οὐ θεοί εἰσιν ἀλλ' ἢ ἔργα χειρῶν ἀνθρώπων ξύλα καὶ λίθοι καὶ ἀπώλεσαν αὐτούς

text_en: Now therefore, O Lord our God , save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are the Lord , the only God .
text_la: Nunc igitur Domine Deus noster, salvos nos fac de manu ejus, ut sciant omnia regna terræ quia tu es Dominus Deus solus.
text_pt: Agora, pois, ó Senhor nosso Deus, te suplico, livra-nos da sua mão; e assim saberão todos os reinos da terra que só tu és o Senhor Deus.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν σῶσον ἡμᾶς ἐκ χειρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ γνώσονται πᾶσαι αἱ βασιλεῖαι τῆς γῆς ὅτι σὺ κύριος ὁ θεὸς μόνος

text_en: And Isaiah , the son of Amos, sent to Ezechias , saying: Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel : I have heard the prayer you have made to me concerning Sennacherib, king of the Assyrians .
text_la: Misit autem Isaias filius Amos ad Ezechiam, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Quæ deprecatus es me super Sennacherib rege Assyriorum, audivi.
text_pt: Então Isaías, filho de Amós, mandou dizer a Ezequias: Assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: O que me pediste acerca de Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, ouvi.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ησαιας υἱὸς Αμως πρὸς Εζεκιαν λέγων τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἃ προσηύξω πρός με περὶ Σενναχηριμ βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων ἤκουσα

text_en: This is the word that the Lord has spoken of him:The virgin, the daughter of Sion, has despised you, and laughed you to scorn: the daughter of Jerusalem has wagged her head behind your back.
text_la: Iste est sermo, quem locutus est Dominus de eo : Sprevit te, et subsannavit te, virgo filia Sion : post tergum tuum caput movit, filia Jerusalem.
text_pt: Esta é a palavra que o Senhor falou dele: A virgem, a filha de Sião, te despreza, de ti zomba; a filha de Jerusalém meneia a cabeça por detrás de ti.
text_el: οὗτος ὁ λόγος ὃν ἐλάλησεν κύριος ἐπ' αὐτόν ἐξουδένησέν σε καὶ ἐμυκτήρισέν σε παρθένος θυγάτηρ Σιων ἐπὶ σοὶ κεφαλὴν αὐτῆς ἐκίνησεν θυγάτηρ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Whom have you reproached, and whom have you blasphemed ? Against whom have you exalted your voice, and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the holy one of Israel .
text_la: Cui exprobrasti, et quem blasphemasti? contra quem exaltasti vocem tuam, et elevasti in excelsum oculos tuos? Contra Sanctum Israël.
text_pt: A quem afrontaste e blasfemaste? E contra quem alçaste a voz e ergueste os teus olhos ao alto? Contra o Santo de Israel?
text_el: τίνα ὠνείδισας καὶ ἐβλασφήμησας καὶ ἐπὶ τίνα ὕψωσας φωνήν καὶ ἦρας εἰς ὕψος τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου εἰς τὸν ἅγιον τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: By the hand of your servants you have reproached the Lord , and have said: With the multitude of my chariots I have gone up to the height of the mountains, to the top of Libanus, and have cut down its tall cedars , and its choice fir trees. And I have entered into the furthest parts thereof, and the forest of its Carmel .
text_la: Per manum servorum tuorum exprobrasti Domino, et dixisti : In multitudine curruum meorum ascendi excelsa montium in summitate Libani, et succidi sublimes cedros ejus, et electas abietes illius. Et ingressus sum usque ad terminos ejus, et saltum Carmeli ejus
text_pt: Por meio de teus mensageiros afrontaste o Senhor, e disseste: Com a multidão de meus carros subi ao alto dos montes, aos lados do Líbano, e cortarei os seus altos cedros e as suas mais formosas faias, e entrarei nas suas pousadas extremas, até no bosque do seu campo fértil.
text_el: ἐν χειρὶ ἀγγέλων σου ὠνείδισας κύριον καὶ εἶπας ἐν τῷ πλήθει τῶν ἁρμάτων μου ἐγὼ ἀναβήσομαι εἰς ὕψος ὀρέων μηροὺς τοῦ Λιβάνου καὶ ἔκοψα τὸ μέγεθος τῆς κέδρου αὐτοῦ τὰ ἐκλεκτὰ κυπαρίσσων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς μελον τέλους αὐτοῦ δρυμοῦ Καρμήλου αὐτοῦ

text_en: I have cut down, and I have drunk strange waters, and have dried up with the soles of my feet all the shut up waters.
text_la: ego succidi. Et bibi aquas alienas, et siccavi vestigiis pedum meorum omnes aquas clausas.
text_pt: Eu cavei, e bebi águas estranhas; e com as plantas de meus pés sequei todos os rios do Egito.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἔψυξα καὶ ἔπιον ὕδατα ἀλλότρια καὶ ἐξηρήμωσα τῷ ἴχνει τοῦ ποδός μου πάντας ποταμοὺς περιοχῆς

text_en: Have you not heard what I have done from the beginning? From the days of old I have formed it, and now I have brought it to effect: that fenced cities of fighting men should be turned to heaps of ruins:
text_la: Numquid non audisti quid ab initio fecerim? ex diebus antiquis plasmavi illud, et nunc adduxi : eruntque in ruinam collium pugnantium civitates munitæ.
text_pt: Porventura não ouviste que já dantes fiz isto, e já desde os dias antigos o planejei? Agora, porém, o fiz vir, para que fosses tu que reduzisses as cidades fortificadas a montões desertos.
text_el: ἔπλασα αὐτήν νῦν ἤγαγον αὐτήν καὶ ἐγενήθη εἰς ἐπάρσεις ἀποικεσιῶν μαχίμων πόλεις ὀχυράς

text_en: And the inhabitants of them were weak of hand, they trembled and were confounded, they became like the grass of the field, and the green herb on the tops of houses, which withered before it came to maturity.
text_la: Et qui sedent in eis, humiles manu, contremuerunt et confusi sunt : facti sunt velut fœnum agri, et virens herba tectorum, quæ arefacta est antequam veniret ad maturitatem.
text_pt: Por isso os moradores delas, com pouca força, ficaram pasmados e confundidos; eram como a erva do campo, e a hortaliça verde, e o feno dos telhados, e o trigo queimado, antes de amadurecer.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν αὐταῖς ἠσθένησαν τῇ χειρί ἔπτηξαν καὶ κατῃσχύνθησαν ἐγένοντο χόρτος ἀγροῦ ἢ χλωρὰ βοτάνη χλόη δωμάτων καὶ πάτημα ἀπέναντι ἑστηκότος

text_en: Your dwelling, and your going out, and your coming in, and your way I knew before, and your rage against me.
text_la: Habitaculum tuum, et egressum tuum, et introitum tuum, et viam tuam ego præscivi, et furorem tuum contra me.
text_pt: Porém o teu assentar, e o teu sair e o teu entrar, e o teu furor contra mim, eu o sei.
text_el: καὶ τὴν καθέδραν σου καὶ τὴν ἔξοδόν σου καὶ τὴν εἴσοδόν σου ἔγνων καὶ τὸν θυμόν σου ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: You have been mad against me, and your pride has come up to my ears: therefore I will put a ring in your nose, and a bit between your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
text_la: Insanisti in me, et superbia tua ascendit in aures meas : ponam itaque circulum in naribus tuis, et camum in labiis tuis, et reducam te in viam per quam venisti.
text_pt: Por causa do teu furor contra mim, e porque a tua revolta subiu aos meus ouvidos, portanto porei o meu anzol no teu nariz e o meu freio nos teus lábios, e te farei voltar pelo caminho por onde vieste.
text_el: διὰ τὸ ὀργισθῆναί σε ἐπ' ἐμὲ καὶ τὸ στρῆνός σου ἀνέβη ἐν τοῖς ὠσίν μου καὶ θήσω τὰ ἄγκιστρά μου ἐν τοῖς μυκτῆρσίν σου καὶ χαλινὸν ἐν τοῖς χείλεσίν σου καὶ ἀποστρέψω σε ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ᾗ ἦλθες ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And to you, O Ezechias , this shall be a sign: Eat this year what you shall find: and in the second year, such things as spring of themselves: but in the third year sow and reap: plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
text_la: Tibi autem, Ezechia, hoc erit signum : comede hoc anno quæ repereris : in secundo autem anno, quæ sponte nascuntur : porro in tertio anno seminate et metite : plantate vineas, et comedite fructum earum.
text_pt: E isto te será por sinal; este ano se comerá o que nascer por si mesmo, e no ano seguinte o que daí proceder; porém, no terceiro ano semeai e segai, plantai vinhas, e comei os seus frutos.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτό σοι τὸ σημεῖον φάγῃ τοῦτον τὸν ἐνιαυτὸν αὐτόματα καὶ τῷ ἔτει τῷ δευτέρῳ τὰ ἀνατέλλοντα καὶ ἔτι τρίτῳ σπορὰ καὶ ἄμητος καὶ φυτεία ἀμπελώνων καὶ φάγεσθε τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῶν

text_en: And whatsoever shall be left of the house of Juda , shall take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
text_la: Et quodcumque reliquum fuerit de domo Juda, mittet radicem deorsum, et faciet fructum sursum.
text_pt: Porque o que escapou da casa de Judá, e restou, tornará a lançar raízes para baixo, e dará fruto para cima.
text_el: καὶ προσθήσει τὸ διασεσῳσμένον οἴκου Ιουδα τὸ ὑπολειφθὲν ῥίζαν κάτω καὶ ποιήσει καρπὸν ἄνω

text_en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and that which shall be saved out of mount Sion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.
text_la: De Jerusalem quippe egredientur reliquiæ, et quod salvetur de monte Sion : zelus Domini exercituum faciet hoc.
text_pt: Porque de Jerusalém sairá o restante, e do monte Sião o que escapou; o zelo do Senhor dos Exércitos fará isto.
text_el: ὅτι ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ ἐξελεύσεται κατάλειμμα καὶ ἀνασῳζόμενος ἐξ ὄρους Σιων ὁ ζῆλος κυρίου τῶν δυνάμεων ποιήσει τοῦτο

text_en: Wherefore thus says the Lord concerning the king of the Assyrians : He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow into it, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a trench about it.
text_la: Quam ob rem hæc dicit Dominus de rege Assyriorum : Non ingredietur urbem hanc, nec mittet in eam sagittam, nec occupabit eam clypeus, nec circumdabit eam munitio.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor acerca do rei da Assíria: Não entrará nesta cidade, nem lançará nela flecha alguma; tampouco virá perante ela com escudo, nem levantará contra ela trincheira alguma.
text_el: οὐχ οὕτως τάδε λέγει κύριος πρὸς βασιλέα Ἀσσυρίων οὐκ εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν πόλιν ταύτην καὶ οὐ τοξεύσει ἐκεῖ βέλος καὶ οὐ προφθάσει αὐτὴν θυρεός καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκχέῃ πρὸς αὐτὴν πρόσχωμα

text_en: By the way that he came he shall return: and into this city he shall not come, says the Lord .
text_la: Per viam qua venit, revertetur : et civitatem hanc non ingredietur, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Pelo caminho por onde vier, por ele voltará; porém nesta cidade não entrará, diz o Senhor.
text_el: τῇ ὁδῷ ᾗ ἦλθεν ἐν αὐτῇ ἀποστραφήσεται καὶ εἰς τὴν πόλιν ταύτην οὐκ εἰσελεύσεται λέγει κύριος

text_en: And I will protect this city, and will save it for my own sake, and for David , my servant's sake.
text_la: Protegamque urbem hanc, et salvabo eam propter me, et propter David servum meum.
text_pt: Porque eu ampararei a esta cidade, para a livrar, por amor de mim e por amor do meu servo Davi.
text_el: καὶ ὑπερασπιῶ ὑπὲρ τῆς πόλεως ταύτης δι' ἐμὲ καὶ διὰ Δαυιδ τὸν δοῦλόν μου

text_en: And it came to pass that night, that an angel of the Lord came, and slew in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and eighty-five thousand. And when he arose early in the morning, he saw all the bodies of the dead.
text_la: Factum est igitur in nocte illa, venit angelus Domini, et percussit in castris Assyriorum centum octoginta quinque millia. Cumque diluculo surrexisset, vidit omnia corpora mortuorum : et recedens abiit,
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que naquela mesma noite saiu o anjo do Senhor, e feriu no arraial dos assírios a cento e oitenta e cinco mil deles; e, levantando-se pela manhã cedo, eis que todos eram cadáveres.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἕως νυκτὸς καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἄγγελος κυρίου καὶ ἐπάταξεν ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ τῶν Ἀσσυρίων ἑκατὸν ὀγδοήκοντα πέντε χιλιάδας καὶ ὤρθρισαν τὸ πρωί καὶ ἰδοὺ πάντες σώματα νεκρά

text_en: And Sennacherib, king of the Assyrians , departing, went away, and he returned and abode in Ninive.
text_la: et reversus est Sennacherib rex Assyriorum, et mansit in Ninive.
text_pt: Então Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, partiu, e se foi, e voltou e ficou em Nínive.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Σενναχηριμ βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων καὶ ᾤκησεν ἐν Νινευη

text_en: And as he was worshipping in the temple of Nesroch, his god, Adramelech and Sarasar, his sons, slew him with the sword, and they fled into the land of the Armenians, and Asarhaddon, his son, reigned in his stead.
text_la: Cumque adoraret in templo Nesroch deum suum, Adramelech et Sarasar filii ejus percusserunt eum gladio, fugeruntque in terram Armeniorum : et regnavit Asarhaddon filius ejus pro eo.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, estando ele prostrado na casa de Nisroque, seu deus, Adrameleque e Sarezer, seus filhos, o feriram à espada; porém eles escaparam para a terra de Ararate; e Esar-Hadom, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτοῦ προσκυνοῦντος ἐν οἴκῳ Νεσεραχ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ Αδραμελεχ καὶ Σαρασαρ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπάταξαν αὐτὸν ἐν μαχαίρᾳ καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐσώθησαν εἰς γῆν Αραρατ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ασορδαν ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: In those days Ezechias was sick unto death: and Isaiah , the son of Amos, the prophet , came and said to him: Thus says the Lord God : Give charge concerning your house, for you shall die, and not live.
text_la: In diebus illis ægrotavit Ezechias usque ad mortem : et venit ad eum Isaias filius Amos propheta, dixitque ei : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Præcipe domui tuæ : morieris enim tu, et non vives.
text_pt: Naqueles dias adoeceu Ezequias mortalmente; e o profeta Isaías, filho de Amós, veio a ele e lhe disse: Assim diz o SENHOR: Põe em ordem a tua casa, porque morrerás, e não viverás.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἠρρώστησεν Εζεκιας εἰς θάνατον καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Ησαιας υἱὸς Αμως ὁ προφήτης καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἔντειλαι τῷ οἴκῳ σου ὅτι ἀποθνῄσκεις σὺ καὶ οὐ ζήσῃ

text_en: And he turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the Lord , saying:
text_la: Qui convertit faciem suam ad parietem, et oravit Dominum, dicens:
text_pt: Então virou o rosto para a parede, e orou ao Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Εζεκιας τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν τοῖχον καὶ ηὔξατο πρὸς κύριον λέγων

text_en: I beseech you, O Lord , remember how I have walked before you in truth , and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is pleasing before you. And Ezechias wept with much weeping.
text_la: Obsecro, Domine : memento, quæso, quomodo ambulaverim coram te in veritate, et in corde perfecto, et quod placitum est coram te fecerim. Flevit itaque Ezechias fletu magno.
text_pt: Ah, Senhor! Suplico-te lembrar de que andei diante de ti em verdade, com o coração perfeito, e fiz o que era bom aos teus olhos. E chorou Ezequias muitíssimo.
text_el: ὦ δή κύριε μνήσθητι δὴ ὅσα περιεπάτησα ἐνώπιόν σου ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ ἐν καρδίᾳ πλήρει καὶ τὸ ἀγαθὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου ἐποίησα καὶ ἔκλαυσεν Εζεκιας κλαυθμῷ μεγάλῳ

text_en: And before Isaiah had gone out of the middle of the court , the word of the Lord came to him, saying:
text_la: Et antequam egrederetur Isaias mediam partem atrii, factus est sermo Domini ad eum, dicens:
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que, não havendo Isaías ainda saído do meio do pátio, veio a ele a palavra do Senhor dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἦν Ησαιας ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τῇ μέσῃ καὶ ῥῆμα κυρίου ἐγένετο πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγων

text_en: Go back, and tell Ezechias , the captain of my people: Thus says the Lord , the God of David , your father: I have heard your prayer , and I have seen your tears: and behold I have healed you: on the third day you shall go up to the temple of the Lord .
text_la: Revertere, et dic Ezechiæ duci populi mei : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus David patris tui : Audivi orationem tuam, et vidi lacrimas tuas, et ecce sanavi te : die tertio ascendes templum Domini.
text_pt: Volta, e dize a Ezequias, capitão do meu povo: Assim diz o Senhor, o Deus de Davi, teu pai: Ouvi a tua oração, e vi as tuas lágrimas; eis que eu te sararei; ao terceiro dia subirás à casa do Senhor.
text_el: ἐπίστρεψον καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς Εζεκιαν τὸν ἡγούμενον τοῦ λαοῦ μου τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρός σου ἤκουσα τῆς προσευχῆς σου εἶδον τὰ δάκρυά σου ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἰάσομαί σε τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ ἀναβήσῃ εἰς οἶκον κυρίου

text_en: And I will add to your days fifteen years: and I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians , and I will protect this city for my own sake, and for David , my servant's sake.
text_la: Et addam diebus tuis quindecim annos : sed et de manu regis Assyriorum liberabo te, et civitatem hanc : et protegam urbem istam propter me, et propter David servum meum.
text_pt: E acrescentarei aos teus dias quinze anos, e das mãos do rei da Assíria te livrarei, a ti e a esta cidade; e ampararei esta cidade por amor de mim, e por amor de Davi, meu servo.
text_el: καὶ προσθήσω ἐπὶ τὰς ἡμέρας σου πέντε καὶ δέκα ἔτη καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων σώσω σε καὶ τὴν πόλιν ταύτην καὶ ὑπερασπιῶ ὑπὲρ τῆς πόλεως ταύτης δι' ἐμὲ καὶ διὰ Δαυιδ τὸν δοῦλόν μου

text_en: And Isaiah said: Bring me a lump of figs. And when they had brought it, and laid it upon his boil, he was healed.
text_la: Dixitque Isaias : Afferte massam ficorum. Quam cum attulissent, et posuissent super ulcus ejus, curatus est.
text_pt: Disse mais Isaías: Tomai uma pasta de figos. E a tomaram, e a puseram sobre a chaga; e ele sarou.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν λαβέτωσαν παλάθην σύκων καὶ ἐπιθέτωσαν ἐπὶ τὸ ἕλκος καὶ ὑγιάσει

text_en: And Ezechias had said to Isaiah : What shall be the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I will go up to the temple of the Lord the third day?
text_la: Dixerat autem Ezechias ad Isaiam : Quod erit signum, quia Dominus me sanabit, et quia ascensurus sum die tertia templum Domini?
text_pt: E Ezequias disse a Isaías: Qual é o sinal de que o Senhor me sarará, e de que ao terceiro dia subirei à casa do Senhor?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Εζεκιας πρὸς Ησαιαν τί τὸ σημεῖον ὅτι ἰάσεταί με κύριος καὶ ἀναβήσομαι εἰς οἶκον κυρίου τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ

text_en: And Isaiah said to him: This shall be the sign from the Lord , that the Lord will do the word which he has spoken: Will you that the shadow go forward ten lines, or that it go back so many degrees?
text_la: Cui ait Isaias : Hoc erit signum a Domino quod facturus sit Dominus sermonem quem locutus est : vis ut ascendat umbra decem lineis, an ut revertatur totidem gradibus?
text_pt: Disse Isaías: Isto te será sinal, da parte do Senhor, de que o Senhor cumprirá a palavra que disse: Adiantar-se-á a sombra dez graus, ou voltará dez graus atrás?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ησαιας τοῦτο τὸ σημεῖον παρὰ κυρίου ὅτι ποιήσει κύριος τὸν λόγον ὃν ἐλάλησεν πορεύσεται ἡ σκιὰ δέκα βαθμούς ἐὰν ἐπιστρέφῃ δέκα βαθμούς

text_en: And Ezechias said: It is an easy matter for the shadow to go forward ten lines: and I do not desire that this be done, but let it return back ten degrees.
text_la: Et ait Ezechias : Facile est umbram crescere decem lineis : nec hoc volo ut fiat, sed ut revertatur retrorsum decem gradibus.
text_pt: Então disse Ezequias: É fácil que a sombra decline dez graus; não seja assim, mas volte a sombra dez graus atrás.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Εζεκιας κοῦφον τὴν σκιὰν κλῖναι δέκα βαθμούς οὐχί ἀλλ' ἐπιστραφήτω ἡ σκιὰ δέκα βαθμοὺς εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω

text_en: And Isaiah, the prophet , called upon the Lord , and he brought the shadow ten degrees backwards by the lines, by which it had already gone down on the dial of Achaz .
text_la: Invocavit itaque Isaias propheta Dominum, et reduxit umbram per lineas quibus jam descenderat in horologio Achaz, retrorsum decem gradibus.
text_pt: Então o profeta Isaías clamou ao Senhor; e fez voltar a sombra dez graus atrás, pelos graus que tinha declinado no relógio de sol de Acaz.
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησεν Ησαιας ὁ προφήτης πρὸς κύριον καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν ἡ σκιὰ ἐν τοῖς ἀναβαθμοῖς εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω δέκα βαθμούς

text_en: At that time Berodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, king of the Babylonians , sent letters and presents to Ezechias : for he had heard that Ezechias had been sick.
text_la: In tempore illo misit Berodach Baladan, filius Baladan, rex Babyloniorum, litteras et munera ad Ezechiam : audierat enim quod ægrotasset Ezechias.
text_pt: Naquele tempo enviou Berodaque-Baladã, filho de Baladã, rei de babilônia, cartas e um presente a Ezequias; porque ouvira que Ezequias tinha estado doente.
text_el: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἀπέστειλεν Μαρωδαχβαλαδαν υἱὸς Βαλαδαν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος βιβλία καὶ μαναα πρὸς Εζεκιαν ὅτι ἤκουσεν ὅτι ἠρρώστησεν Εζεκιας

text_en: And Ezechias rejoiced at their coming, and he showed them the house of his aromatical spices, and the gold, and the silver, and divers precious odours, and ointments , and the house of his vessels, and all that he had in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominions, that Ezechias showed them not.
text_la: Lætatus est autem in adventu eorum Ezechias, et ostendit eis domum aromatum, et aurum et argentum, et pigmenta varia, unguenta quoque, et domum vasorum suorum, et omnia quæ habere poterat in thesauris suis. Non fuit quod non monstraret eis Ezechias in domo sua, et in omni potestate sua.
text_pt: E Ezequias lhes deu ouvidos; e lhes mostrou toda a casa de seu tesouro, a prata, o ouro, as especiarias e os melhores ungüentos, e a sua casa de armas, e tudo quanto se achou nos seus tesouros; coisa nenhuma houve que não lhes mostrasse, nem em sua casa, nem em todo o seu domínio.
text_el: καὶ ἐχάρη ἐπ' αὐτοῖς Εζεκιας καὶ ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς ὅλον τὸν οἶκον τοῦ νεχωθα τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸ χρυσίον τὰ ἀρώματα καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον τὸ ἀγαθόν καὶ τὸν οἶκον τῶν σκευῶν καὶ ὅσα ηὑρέθη ἐν τοῖς θησαυροῖς αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἦν λόγος ὃν οὐκ ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς Εζεκιας ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Isaiah, the prophet , came to King Ezechias , and said to him: What said these men ? Or from whence came they to you? And Ezechias said to him: From a far country, they came to me out of Babylon .
text_la: Venit autem Isaias propheta ad regem Ezechiam, dixitque ei : Quid dixerunt viri isti? aut unde venerunt ad te? Cui ait Ezechias : De terra longinqua venerunt ad me, de Babylone.
text_pt: Então o profeta Isaías veio ao rei Ezequias, e lhe disse: Que disseram aqueles homens, e de onde vieram a ti? Disse Ezequias: Vieram de um país muito remoto, de babilônia.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Ησαιας ὁ προφήτης πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Εζεκιαν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν τί ἐλάλησαν οἱ ἄνδρες οὗτοι καὶ πόθεν ἥκασιν πρὸς σέ καὶ εἶπεν Εζεκιας ἐκ γῆς πόρρωθεν ἥκασιν πρός με ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: And he said: What did they see in your house? Ezechias said: They saw all the things that are in my house: There is nothing among my treasures that I have not showed them.
text_la: At ille respondit : Quid viderunt in domo tua? Ait Ezechias : Omnia quæcumque sunt in domo mea, viderunt : nihil est quod non monstraverim eis in thesauris meis.
text_pt: E disse ele: Que viram em tua casa? E disse Ezequias: Tudo quanto há em minha casa viram; coisa nenhuma há nos meus tesouros que eu não lhes mostrasse.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τί εἶδον ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου καὶ εἶπεν πάντα ὅσα ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου εἶδον οὐκ ἦν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου ὃ οὐκ ἔδειξα αὐτοῖς ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ ἐν τοῖς θησαυροῖς μου

text_en: And Isaiah said to Ezechias : Hear the word of the Lord .
text_la: Dixit itaque Isaias Ezechiæ : Audi sermonem Domini:
text_pt: Então disse Isaías a Ezequias: Ouve a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ησαιας πρὸς Εζεκιαν ἄκουσον λόγον κυρίου

text_en: Behold the days shall come, that all that is in your house, and that your fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon : nothing shall be left, says the Lord .
text_la: Ecce dies venient, et auferentur omnia quæ sunt in domo tua, et quæ condiderunt patres tui usque in diem hanc, in Babylonem : non remanebit quidquam, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Eis que vêm dias em que tudo quanto houver em tua casa, e o que entesouraram teus pais até ao dia de hoje, será levado a babilônia; não ficará coisa alguma, disse o SENHOR.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται καὶ λημφθήσεται πάντα τὰ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου καὶ ὅσα ἐθησαύρισαν οἱ πατέρες σου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης εἰς Βαβυλῶνα καὶ οὐχ ὑπολειφθήσεται ῥῆμα ὃ εἶπεν κύριος

text_en: And of your sons also that shall issue from you, whom you shall beget, they shall take away, and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .
text_la: Sed et de filiis tuis qui egredientur ex te, quos generabis, tollentur, et erunt eunuchi in palatio regis Babylonis.
text_pt: E ainda até de teus filhos, que procederem de ti, e que tu gerares, tomarão, para que sejam eunucos no paço do rei da babilônia.
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου οἳ ἐξελεύσονται ἐκ σοῦ οὓς γεννήσεις λήμψεται καὶ ἔσονται εὐνοῦχοι ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: Ezechias said to Isaiah : The word of the Lord , which you have spoken, is good : let peace and truth be in my days.
text_la: Dixit Ezechias ad Isaiam : Bonus sermo Domini quem locutus es : sit pax et veritas in diebus meis.
text_pt: Então disse Ezequias a Isaías: Boa é a palavra do Senhor que disseste. Disse mais: E não haverá, pois, em meus dias paz e verdade?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Εζεκιας πρὸς Ησαιαν ἀγαθὸς ὁ λόγος κυρίου ὃν ἐλάλησεν ἔστω εἰρήνη ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις μου

text_en: And the rest of the acts of Ezechias , and all his might, and how he made a pool , and a conduit, and brought waters into the city, are they not written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Juda ?
text_la: Reliqua autem sermonum Ezechiæ, et omnis fortitudo ejus, et quomodo fecerit piscinam et aquæductum, et introduxerit aquas in civitatem, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Juda?
text_pt: Ora, o mais dos atos de Ezequias, e todo o seu poder, e como fez a piscina e o aqueduto, e como fez vir a água à cidade, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
text_el: καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν λόγων Εζεκιου καὶ πᾶσα ἡ δυναστεία αὐτοῦ καὶ ὅσα ἐποίησεν τὴν κρήνην καὶ τὸν ὑδραγωγὸν καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν τὸ ὕδωρ εἰς τὴν πόλιν οὐχὶ ταῦτα γεγραμμένα ἐπὶ βιβλίῳ λόγων τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν Ιουδα

text_en: And Ezechias slept with his fathers, and Manasses , his son reigned in his stead.
text_la: Dormivitque Ezechias cum patribus suis, et regnavit Manasses filius ejus pro eo.
text_pt: E Ezequias dormiu com seus pais; e Manassés, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Εζεκιας μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν πόλει Δαυιδ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Μανασσης υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: Manasses was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned five and fifty years in Jerusalem : the name of his mother was Haphsiba.
text_la: Duodecim annorum erat Manasses cum regnare cœpisset, et quinquaginta quinque annis regnavit in Jerusalem : nomen matris ejus Haphsiba.
text_pt: Tinha Manassés doze anos de idade quando começou a reinar, e cinqüenta e cinco anos reinou em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Hefzibá.
text_el: υἱὸς δώδεκα ἐτῶν Μανασσης ἐν τῷ βασιλεύειν αὐτὸν καὶ πεντήκοντα καὶ πέντε ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Οψιβα

text_en: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord , according to the idols of the nations, which the Lord destroyed from before the face of the children of Israel .
text_la: Fecitque malum in conspectu Domini, juxta idola gentium quas delevit Dominus a facie filiorum Israël.
text_pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor, conforme as abominações dos gentios que o Senhor expulsara de suas possessões, de diante dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ πονηρὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς κυρίου κατὰ τὰ βδελύγματα τῶν ἐθνῶν ὧν ἐξῆρεν κύριος ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And he turned, and built up the high places, which Ezechias , his father, had destroyed: and he set up altars to Baal , and made groves, as Achab , the king of Israel , had done: and he adored all the host of heaven , and served them.
text_la: Conversusque est, et ædificavit excelsa quæ dissipaverat Ezechias pater ejus : et erexit aras Baal, et fecit lucos sicut fecerat Achab rex Israël, et adoravit omnem militiam cæli, et coluit eam.
text_pt: Porque tornou a edificar os altos que Ezequias, seu pai, tinha destruído, e levantou altares a Baal, e fez um bosque como o que fizera Acabe, rei de Israel, e se inclinou diante de todo o exército dos céus, e os serviu.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὰ ὑψηλά ἃ κατέσπασεν Εζεκιας ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνέστησεν θυσιαστήριον τῇ Βααλ καὶ ἐποίησεν ἄλση καθὼς ἐποίησεν Αχααβ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ προσεκύνησεν πάσῃ τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἐδούλευσεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And he built altars in the house of the Lord , of which the Lord said: In Jerusalem I will put my name .
text_la: Exstruxitque aras in domo Domini, de qua dixit Dominus : In Jerusalem ponam nomen meum.
text_pt: E edificou altares na casa do Senhor, da qual o Senhor tinha falado: Em Jerusalém porei o meu nome.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν θυσιαστήριον ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου ὡς εἶπεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ θήσω τὸ ὄνομά μου

text_en: And he built altars for all the host of heaven , in the two courts of the temple of the Lord .
text_la: Et exstruxit altaria universæ militiæ cæli in duobus atriis templi Domini.
text_pt: Também edificou altares a todo o exército dos céus em ambos os átrios da casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν θυσιαστήριον πάσῃ τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐν ταῖς δυσὶν αὐλαῖς οἴκου κυρίου

text_en: And he made his son pass through fire: and he used divinations, and observed omens, and appointed pythons, and multiplied soothsayers, to do evil before the Lord , and to provoke him.
text_la: Et traduxit filium suum per ignem : et ariolatus est, et observavit auguria, et fecit pythones, et aruspices multiplicavit, ut faceret malum coram Domino, et irritaret eum.
text_pt: E até fez passar a seu filho pelo fogo, adivinhava pelas nuvens, era agoureiro e ordenou adivinhos e feiticeiros; e prosseguiu em fazer o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor, para o provocar à ira.
text_el: καὶ διῆγεν τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐν πυρὶ καὶ ἐκληδονίζετο καὶ οἰωνίζετο καὶ ἐποίησεν θελητὴν καὶ γνώστας ἐπλήθυνεν τοῦ ποιεῖν τὸ πονηρὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς κυρίου παροργίσαι αὐτόν

text_en: He set also an idol of the grove, which he had made, in the temple of the Lord : concerning which the Lord said to David , and to Solomon his son: In this temple , and in Jerusalem , which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel , I will put my name for ever.
text_la: Posuit quoque idolum luci quem fecerat, in templo Domini, super quod locutus est Dominus ad David, et ad Salomonem filium ejus : In templo hoc, et in Jerusalem quam elegi de cunctis tribubus Israël, ponam nomen meum in sempiternum.
text_pt: Também pôs uma imagem de escultura, do bosque que tinha feito, na casa de que o Senhor dissera a Davi e a Salomão, seu filho: Nesta casa e em Jerusalém, que escolhi de todas as tribos de Israel, porei o meu nome para sempre;
text_el: καὶ ἔθηκεν τὸ γλυπτὸν τοῦ ἄλσους ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ ᾧ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Δαυιδ καὶ πρὸς Σαλωμων τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τούτῳ καὶ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ᾗ ἐξελεξάμην ἐκ πασῶν φυλῶν Ισραηλ καὶ θήσω τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐκεῖ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And I will no more make the feet of Israel to be moved out of the land, which I gave to their fathers: only if they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, according to the law which my servant Moses commanded them.
text_la: Et ultra non faciam commoveri pedem Israël de terra quam dedi patribus eorum : si tamen custodierint opere omnia quæ præcepi eis, et universam legem quam mandavit eis servus meus Moyses.
text_pt: E não mais farei mover o pé de Israel desta terra que tenho dado a seus pais; contanto que somente tenham cuidado de fazer conforme tudo o que lhes tenho ordenado, e conforme toda a lei que Moisés, meu servo, lhes ordenou.
text_el: καὶ οὐ προσθήσω τοῦ σαλεῦσαι τὸν πόδα Ισραηλ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἧς ἔδωκα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν οἵτινες φυλάξουσιν πάντα ὅσα ἐνετειλάμην κατὰ πᾶσαν τὴν ἐντολήν ἣν ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς ὁ δοῦλός μου Μωυσῆς

text_en: But they hearkened not: but were seduced by Manasses , to do evil more than the nations which the Lord destroyed before the children of Israel .
text_la: Illi vero non audierunt : sed seducti sunt a Manasse, ut facerent malum super gentes quas contrivit Dominus a facie filiorum Israël.
text_pt: Porém não ouviram; porque Manassés de tal modo os fez errar, que fizeram pior do que as nações, que o Senhor tinha destruído de diante dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν καὶ ἐπλάνησεν αὐτοὺς Μανασσης τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς κυρίου ὑπὲρ τὰ ἔθνη ἃ ἠφάνισεν κύριος ἐκ προσώπου υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord spoke in the hand of his servants, the prophets , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus in manu servorum suorum prophetarum, dicens:
text_pt: Então o Senhor falou pelo ministério de seus servos, os profetas, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος ἐν χειρὶ δούλων αὐτοῦ τῶν προφητῶν λέγων

text_en: Because Manasses , king of Juda , has done these most wicked abominations, beyond all that the Amorrhites did before him, and has made Juda also to sin with his filthy doings:
text_la: Quia fecit Manasses rex Juda abominationes istas pessimas, super omnia quæ fecerunt Amorrhæi ante eum, et peccare fecit etiam Judam in immunditiis suis:
text_pt: Porquanto Manassés, rei de Judá, fez estas abominações, fazendo pior do que tudo quanto fizeram os amorreus, que foram antes dele, e até também a Judá fez pecar com os seus ídolos;
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν ὅσα ἐποίησεν Μανασσης ὁ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα τὰ βδελύγματα ταῦτα τὰ πονηρὰ ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν ἐποίησεν ὁ Αμορραῖος ὁ ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ἐξήμαρτεν καί γε Ιουδα ἐν τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord , the God of Israel : Behold, I will bring on evils upon Jerusalem and Juda : that whosoever shall hear of them, both his ears shall tingle.
text_la: propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Ecce ego inducam mala super Jerusalem et Judam, ut quicumque audierit, tinniant ambæ aures ejus.
text_pt: Por isso, assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: Eis que hei de trazer um mal sobre Jerusalém e Judá, que qualquer que ouvir, lhe ficarão retinindo ambos os ouvidos.
text_el: οὐχ οὕτως τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ φέρω κακὰ ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐπὶ Ιουδα ὥστε παντὸς ἀκούοντος ἠχήσει ἀμφότερα τὰ ὦτα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria , and the weight of the house of Achab : and I will efface Jerusalem , as writings tables are wont to be effaced, and I will erase and turn it, and draw the pencil often over the face thereof.
text_la: Et extendam super Jerusalem funiculum Samariæ, et pondus domus Achab : et delebo Jerusalem, sicut deleri solent tabulæ : et delens vertam, et ducam crebrius stylum super faciem ejus.
text_pt: E estenderei sobre Jerusalém o cordel de Samaria e o prumo da casa de Acabe; e limparei a Jerusalém, como quem limpa o prato, limpa-o e vira-o para baixo.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτενῶ ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ τὸ μέτρον Σαμαρείας καὶ τὸ στάθμιον οἴκου Αχααβ καὶ ἀπαλείψω τὴν Ιερουσαλημ καθὼς ἀπαλείφεται ὁ ἀλάβαστρος ἀπαλειφόμενος καὶ καταστρέφεται ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I will leave the remnants of my inheritance, and will deliver them into the hands of their enemies: and they shall become a prey, and a spoil to all their enemies.
text_la: Dimittam vero reliquias hæreditatis meæ, et tradam eas in manus inimicorum ejus, eruntque in vastitatem, et in rapinam cunctis adversariis suis:
text_pt: E desampararei os restantes da minha herança, entregá-los-ei na mão de seus inimigos; e servirão de presa e despojo para todos os seus inimigos;
text_el: καὶ ἀπώσομαι τὸ ὑπόλειμμα τῆς κληρονομίας μου καὶ παραδώσω αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἔσονται εἰς διαρπαγὴν καὶ εἰς προνομὴν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐχθροῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: Because they have done evil before me, and have continued to provoke me, from the day that their fathers came out of Egypt , even unto this day.
text_la: eo quod fecerint malum coram me, et perseveraverint irritantes me, ex die qua egressi sunt patres eorum ex Ægypto usque ad hanc diem.
text_pt: Porquanto fizeram o que era mau aos meus olhos e me provocaram à ira, desde o dia em que seus pais saíram do Egito até hoje.
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν ὅσα ἐποίησαν τὸ πονηρὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς μου καὶ ἦσαν παροργίζοντές με ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἐξήγαγον τοὺς πατέρας αὐτῶν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: Moreover, Manasses shed also very much innocent blood, till he filled Jerusalem up to the mouth: besides his sins , wherewith he made Juda to sin , to do evil before the Lord .
text_la: Insuper et sanguinem innoxium fudit Manasses multum nimis, donec impleret Jerusalem usque ad os : absque peccatis suis quibus peccare fecit Judam, ut faceret malum coram Domino.
text_pt: Além disso, também Manassés derramou muitíssimo sangue inocente, até que encheu a Jerusalém de um ao outro extremo, afora o seu pecado, com que fez Judá pecar, fazendo o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor.
text_el: καί γε αἷμα ἀθῷον ἐξέχεεν Μανασσης πολὺ σφόδρα ἕως οὗ ἔπλησεν τὴν Ιερουσαλημ στόμα εἰς στόμα πλὴν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτοῦ ὧν ἐξήμαρτεν τὸν Ιουδαν τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς κυρίου

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasses , and all that he did, and his sin , which he sinned , are they not written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Juda ?
text_la: Reliqua autem sermonum Manasse, ut universa quæ fecit, et peccatum ejus quod peccavit, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Juda?
text_pt: Quanto ao mais dos feitos de Manassés, e a tudo quanto fez, e ao seu pecado, que praticou, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
text_el: καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν λόγων Μανασση καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν καὶ ἡ ἁμαρτία αὐτοῦ ἣν ἥμαρτεν οὐχὶ ταῦτα γεγραμμένα ἐπὶ βιβλίῳ λόγων τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν Ιουδα

text_en: And Manasses slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Oza: and Amon, his son, reigned in his stead.
text_la: Dormivitque Manasses cum patribus suis, et sepultus est in horto domus suæ, in horto Oza : et regnavit Amon filius ejus pro eo.
text_pt: E Manassés dormiu com seus pais, e foi sepultado no jardim da sua casa, no jardim de Uzá; e Amom, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Μανασσης μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν τῷ κήπῳ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ ἐν κήπῳ Οζα καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Αμων υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: Two and twenty years old was Amon when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem : the name of his mother was Messalemeth, the daughter of Harus, of Jeteba.
text_la: Viginti duorum annorum erat Amon cum regnare cœpisset : duobus quoque annis regnavit in Jerusalem : nomen matris ejus Messalemeth filia Harus de Jeteba.
text_pt: Tinha Amom vinte e dois anos de idade quando começou a reinar, e dois anos reinou em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Mesulemete, filha de Harus, de Jotbá.
text_el: υἱὸς εἴκοσι καὶ δύο ἐτῶν Αμων ἐν τῷ βασιλεύειν αὐτὸν καὶ δύο ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Μεσολλαμ θυγάτηρ Αρους ἐξ Ιετεβα

text_en: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord , as Manasses , his father, had done.
text_la: Fecitque malum in conspectu Domini, sicut fecerat Manasses pater ejus.
text_pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor, como fizera Manassés, seu pai.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ πονηρὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς κυρίου καθὼς ἐποίησεν Μανασσης ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he walked in all the way in which his father had walked: and he served the abominations which his father had served, and he adored them.
text_la: Et ambulavit in omni via per quam ambulaverat pater ejus, servivitque immunditiis quibus servierat pater ejus, et adoravit eas:
text_pt: Porque andou em todo o caminho em que andara seu pai; e serviu os ídolos, a que seu pai tinha servido, e se inclinou diante deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν πάσῃ ὁδῷ ᾗ ἐπορεύθη ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐλάτρευσεν τοῖς εἰδώλοις οἷς ἐλάτρευσεν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And forsook the Lord , the God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the Lord .
text_la: et dereliquit Dominum Deum patrum suorum, et non ambulavit in via Domini.
text_pt: Assim deixou ao Senhor Deus de seus pais, e não andou no caminho do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐγκατέλιπεν τὸν κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐπορεύθη ἐν ὁδῷ κυρίου

text_en: And his servants plotted against him, and slew the king in his own house.
text_la: Tetenderuntque ei insidias servi sui, et interfecerunt regem in domo sua.
text_pt: E os servos de Amom conspiraram contra ele, e mataram o rei em sua casa.
text_el: καὶ συνεστράφησαν οἱ παῖδες Αμων πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἐθανάτωσαν τὸν βασιλέα ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against King Amon: and made Josias , his son, their king in his stead.
text_la: Percussit autem populus terræ omnes qui conjuraverant contra regem Amon, et constituerunt sibi regem Josiam filium ejus pro eo.
text_pt: Porém o povo da terra feriu a todos os que conspiraram contra o rei Amom; e o povo da terra pôs Josias, seu filho, rei em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τῆς γῆς πάντας τοὺς συστραφέντας ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα Αμων καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ὁ λαὸς τῆς γῆς τὸν Ιωσιαν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: But the rest of the acts of Amon, which he did, are they not written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Juda ?
text_la: Reliqua autem sermonum Amon quæ fecit, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Juda?
text_pt: Quanto ao mais dos atos de Amom, que fez, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
text_el: καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν λόγων Αμων ὅσα ἐποίησεν οὐκ ἰδοὺ ταῦτα γεγραμμένα ἐπὶ βιβλίῳ λόγων τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν Ιουδα

text_en: And they buried him in his sepulchre, in the garden of Oza: and his son, Josias , reigned in his stead.
text_la: Sepelieruntque eum in sepulchro suo, in horto Oza : et regnavit Josias filius ejus pro eo.
text_pt: E o sepultaram na sua sepultura, no jardim de Uzá; e Josias, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ τάφῳ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κήπῳ Οζα καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ιωσιας υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: Josias was eight years old when he began to reign: he reigned one and thirty years in Jerusalem : the name of his mother was Idida, the daughter of Hadaia, of Besecath.
text_la: Octo annorum erat Josias cum regnare cœpisset : triginta et uno anno regnavit in Jerusalem : nomen matris ejus Idida filia Hadaia de Besecath.
text_pt: Tinha Josias oito anos de idade quando começou a reinar, e reinou trinta e um anos em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe, Jedida, filha de Adaías, de Bozcate.
text_el: υἱὸς ὀκτὼ ἐτῶν Ιωσιας ἐν τῷ βασιλεύειν αὐτὸν καὶ τριάκοντα καὶ ἓν ἔτος ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Ιεδιδα θυγάτηρ Εδεϊα ἐκ Βασουρωθ

text_en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord , and walked in all the ways of David , his father: he turned not aside to the right hand, or to the left.
text_la: Fecitque quod placitum erat coram Domino, et ambulavit per omnes vias David patris sui : non declinavit ad dexteram, sive ad sinistram.
text_pt: E fez o que era reto aos olhos do Senhor; e andou em todo o caminho de Davi, seu pai, e não se apartou dele nem para a direita nem para a esquerda.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ εὐθὲς ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς κυρίου καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν πάσῃ ὁδῷ Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἀπέστη δεξιὰ ἢ ἀριστερά

text_en: And in the eighteenth year of King Josias , the king sent Saphan, the son of Assia, the son of Messulam, the scribe of the temple of the Lord , saying to him:
text_la: Anno autem octavodecimo regis Josiæ, misit rex Saphan filium Aslia filii Messulam scribam templi Domini, dicens ei:
text_pt: Sucedeu que, no ano décimo oitavo do rei Josias, o rei mandou ao escrivão Safã, filho de Azalias, filho de Mesulão, à casa do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ ὀκτωκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει τῷ βασιλεῖ Ιωσια ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ὀγδόῳ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν Σαφφαν υἱὸν Εσελιου υἱοῦ Μεσολλαμ τὸν γραμματέα οἴκου κυρίου λέγων

text_en: Go to Helcias, the high priest , that the money may be put together which is brought into the temple of the Lord , which the doorkeepers of the temple have gathered of the people.
text_la: Vade ad Helciam sacerdotem magnum, ut confletur pecunia quæ illata est in templum Domini, quam collegerunt janitores templi a populo:
text_pt: Sobe a Hilquias, o sumo sacerdote, para que tome o dinheiro que se trouxe à casa do Senhor, o qual os guardas do umbral da porta ajuntaram do povo,
text_el: ἀνάβηθι πρὸς Χελκιαν τὸν ἱερέα τὸν μέγαν καὶ σφράγισον τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ εἰσενεχθὲν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου ὃ συνήγαγον οἱ φυλάσσοντες τὸν σταθμὸν παρὰ τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And let it be given to the workmen by the overseers of the house of the Lord : and let them distribute it to those that work in the temple of the Lord , to repair the temple :
text_la: deturque fabris per præpositos domus Domini, qui et distribuant eam his qui operantur in templo Domini, ad instauranda sartatecta templi:
text_pt: E que o dêem na mão dos que têm cargo da obra, e estão encarregados da casa do Senhor; para que o dêem àqueles que fazem a obra que há na casa do Senhor, para repararem as fendas da casa;
text_el: καὶ δότωσαν αὐτὸ ἐπὶ χεῖρα ποιούντων τὰ ἔργα τῶν καθεσταμένων ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸ τοῖς ποιοῦσιν τὰ ἔργα τοῖς ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου τοῦ κατισχῦσαι τὸ βεδεκ τοῦ οἴκου
